text.body:
[p. 1] // pañcaskandhakavibhāṣā //
namo buddhāya || pañca skandhā ityādi prakaraṇārambhaḥ /
sa ca dharmasvasāmānyalakṣaṇavyutpattyartham /
nanu ca yogācārabhūmyādiṣu śāstreṣu dharmalakṣaṇaṃ nirdhāritam eveti punas tannirdhāraṇāya yatnavaiyarthyam /
na vaiyarthyam udghaṭitajñavineyārthitvāt /
udghaṭitajñā hi diṅmātreṇa tatsambhavino viśeṣān niravaśeṣān avaboddhuṃ samarthā iti saṅkṣepoktim eva bahu manyante ,
na vistaroktim /
ataś ca saṅkṣiptarucisattvānugrahāyedaṃ prakaraṇam ārabdham iti /
athavā gṛhasthānāṃ bahukṛtyavyāpṛtatvād vistaragrantheṣv abhiyogāsambhavaḥ /
manasikārābhiyuktānāṃ ca pravrajitānām api vistaragranthābhiyogo vikṣepāyaivety ubhayeṣām api dharmalakṣaṇavyutpattyartham iha prakaraṇe dharmalakṣaṇaṃ
samāsenoktam iti nāsti tadārambhavaiyarthyam /
athavā saṅkṣepeṇa dharmalakṣaṇavyutpannā ayatnena dharmalakṣaṇavistarapratipattisamarthā bhaviṣyantīty ato yogācārabhūmyādīnāṃ vistaragranthānāṃ
praveśabhūtam idam ācāryeṇa prakaraṇaṃ kṛtam iti /
kiṃ punar dharmalakṣaṇavyutpattyā vinā na sidhyati yatrācāryo dharmalakṣaṇanirdeśaṃ praty ādriyate /
cittaikāgratā sāṅkathyaviniścayeṣu ca praśna[p. 2]vyākaraṇakauśalam /
tathā hi dharmalakṣaṇakṛtaparicayasya sandehābhāvād yatheṣṭam ālambane cittam ekāgrībhavati nānyathā /
dharmalakṣaṇapravicayāc ca prajñāprakarṣagamanād vaiśāradyaṃ pratilabhate /
viśāradaś ca sāṅkathyaviniścayeṣu sarvapraśnatadvyākaraṇanirdeśasamartho bhavati nānyathā //
pañca skandhā iti nyūnātiriktapratiṣedhena saṅkhyāvadhāraṇam /
nirviśeṣaṇaskandhaśabdaprayogāt sāsravānāsravaskandhopādānam /
pañcaiva skandhā na nyūnā adhikā vā /
ātmātmīyagrāhavastupradarśanārtham ,
prāyeṇa hi bālānāṃ vijñāna evātmagrāhaḥ ,
śeṣeṣu rūpādiṣv ātmīyagrāhaḥ /
tathā hi bāhyādhyātmikasya rūpasya karaṇatvena karmatvena vātmanā sambandha iti rūpaskandha ātmīyagrāhaḥ /
śubhāśubhānāṃ karmaṇāṃ vedanā vipākaḥ ,
tāṃ cātmā saṃvedayata iti vedanāskandha ātmīyagrāhaḥ /
tatra śubhānāṃ karmaṇāṃ sukho 'nubhavo vipākaḥ /
aśubhānāṃ karmaṇāṃ duḥkhaḥ /
ubhayeṣām aduḥkhāsukhaḥ /
atra cālayavijñānasamprayuktopekṣaiva paramārthataḥ karmavipākaḥ ,
śubhāśubhakarmavipākatvād ālayavijñānasya /
sukhaduḥkhayos tu vipākajatvād vipākopacāraḥ /
dṛṣṭaśrutamatavijñāteṣv artheṣv ātmanaḥ sañjñādvāreṇa saṃvyavahāraḥ pravartata iti sañjñāskandha ātmīyagrāhaḥ /
kuśalākuśalādiṣu saṃskārair ātmābhimatasya cittasya preraṇātsaṃskāraskandha ātmīyagrāha iti [p. 3] pañcaiva skandhaḥ //
atha kasmāt skandhānām iyam evānupūrvī /
yathaudārikataḥ /
tatra sarvaudārikaṃ rūpaṃ sapratighatvāt pañcavijñānakāyāśrayatvāt ṣaḍvijñānaviṣayatvāt /
ata ādāv audārikaṃ rūpam uktam /
tribhyaḥ pracāraudārikatayaudārikatarā vedanā /
tathā hy adeśasthām api sañjñādivat pracāraudārikatvād deśaparicchedena tām eva vyapadiśanti na sañjñādīn - haste me vedanā śirasi me vedaneti
ato rūpānantaram uktā /
dvābhyām audārikatarā sañjñānimittodgrahaṇātmakatvena sulakṣyatvāt /
vijñānāt saṃskārā audārikatarāḥ saṃskaraṇalakṣaṇatvena sukhāvabodhatvāt /
sarvaśūkṣmatvād vijñānaṃ sarvapaścād uktam //
rūpaskandha iti samānādhikaraṇo vā syāt ,
ṣaṣṭhītatpuruṣo vā /
na bhavet samānādhikaraṇaḥ ,
adravyatvāt skandhasya /
yasmāt skandhaśabdo rāśiparyāyavacanaḥ ,
tasmād rāśivat prajñaptisantaḥ skandhā iti /
tataś ca sāmānādhikaraṇyābhāvaḥ /
ṣaṣṭhītatpuruṣo 'pi na prāpnoti /
sambandho hi dvayoḥ parasparavibhinnarūpayor bhavati ,
devadattamātulavat /
sambandhārthā ceyaṃ ṣaṣṭhī rūpaskandhayor iti rūpād anya eva [p. 4] skandhaḥ prāpnoti /
na caitad iṣyate ,
prajñaptisataḥ svopādānāt tattvānyatvenāvācyatvāt /
naiṣa doṣaḥ /
abhede 'pi ṣaṣṭhī dṛṣṭā tattvānyatvenāvācye ca -- pratimāyāḥ śarīram ,
rūpasya prāgabhāva iti /
na hi pratimā śarīrād anyā /
prāgabhāvo 'pi nirūpākhyatvāt tattvānyatvenāvācyaḥ ,
svarūpanibandhanatvāt tattvānyatvayoḥ /
anyavastugrahaṇāpekṣaṃ niḥsvabhāvatvād yatra grahaṇam abhidhānaṃ ca tad upādānavyatiriktasvabhāvābhāvāt prajñaptisat /
tathaiva ca skandhārtha iti prajñaptisann ucyate /
ataś ca tattvānyatvenāvācyatve 'pi svopādānāt ṣaṣṭhī na virudhyate /
tataś ca ṣaṣṭhītatpuruṣa evātra //
rūpaṃ katamat /
catvāri mahābhūtāni catvāri ca mahābhūtāny upādāya /
nanu ca skandhānāṃ prakṛtatvāt katamad rūpam ity asambaddhaḥ praśnaḥ /
nāsambaddhaḥ ,
skandhānāṃ niḥsvabhāvatvāt tatsvabhāvavyapadeśena nirdhāraṇam aśakyam ,
kiṃ tarhi tadupādānanirdhāraṇenaiveti /
ato rūpaṃ katamad iti praśnaḥ ,
na rūpaskandha iti /
rūpasya kāryakāraṇabhāvena bhedapradarśanārtham āha -- catvāri mahābhūtānītyādi /
tathā hi sarvāṇi mahābhūtāni sarvasyopādāyarūpasya kāraṇam ,
sarvaṃ copādāyarūpaṃ sarveṣāṃ mahābhūtānāṃ kāryam /
mahattvaṃ bhūtānāṃ sarvopādāyarū[p. 5]pāśrayatvenaudārikatvāt /
athavā sarvarūpādisamudāyeṣu kāṭhinyādisadbhāvān mahāsanniveśatvād mahattvam /
bhūtatvaṃ tu punar eṣāṃ vividhopādāyarūpanirvṛttau tais taiḥ prakārair bhavantīti bhūtāni /
sarvasattvakarmādhipatyād vānādau saṃsāre na kadācin nābhūvann iti bhūtāni /
na cānyeṣāṃ bhūtatvaprasaṅgo mahiṣādivad rūḍhiśabdatvāt /
tāni punaś catvāry eva na nyūnādhikāni ,
asāmarthyāpārthakatvaprasaṅgāt /
bhautikasya hy avadhṛtisnehapācanavyūhanamātrakam eva kāryam /
tasya caitāvadbhir eva parisamāptatvād anyasya ca karaṇīyasyābhāvāt ,
catvāry eva bhūtāni /
nanu ca dhṛtyādivad avakāśam apy upādāyarūpasya kāryam /
tac cākāśena kriyata iti pṛthivyādivad ākāśasyāpi mahābhūtatvaprasaṅgaḥ /
naitad evam /
kiṃ kāraṇam /
na hy ākāśaṃ nāma kiñcid asty anyatra sapratigharūpābhāvamātrāt /
avakāśaṃ ca sapratigham eva vastu svasminn avakāśe sapratighasyaiva tasmād apasaraṃ dadāti ,
nākāśam /
na hi tasmāt pradeśād rūpavad ākāśam apasṛtam iti tasyāvakāśadānaṃ na yujyate /
sapratighaṃ ca rūpaṃ svadeśe 'nyarūpasyotpattiṃ pratibadhnāti ,
nākāśam /
tasmād yatra yasya yasmin saty avakāśābhāvaḥ ,
yasminn asati tasya tatrāvakāśa iti tenaiva tasmāt sthānād apasaratā tasyāvakāśo dattaḥ ,
nākāśeneti /
tasmān nākāśaṃ pṛthivyādivan mahābhūtam //
[p. 6] catvāri ca mahābhūtāny upādāyeti catvāri ca mahābhūtāni rūpaṃ catvāri ca mahābhūtāny upādāya rūpam iti ,
ubhayatrāpi caśabdaḥ sambadhyate /
pañcaprakāreṇa janananiśrayapratiṣṭhopastambhabṛṃhaṇānāṃ hetubhāvena bhautikaṃ bhūtāny upādatta ity upādāyaśabdo hetvarthaḥ ,
tadyathendhanam upādāyāgnir bhavatīti tena nimitteneti gamyate /
tatra jananahetutvaṃ tair vinā tadanutpatteḥ /
niśrayahetutvaṃ bhūtavikāre tatpratiṣṭhitopādāyarūpavikṛtyanuvidhānāt /
sthānahetutvaṃ bhūtānāṃ sadṛśasantānotpattau bhautikasyāpi sadṛśasantānānucchedahetutvāt /
upastambhahetutvaṃ tadvaśenānucchedāt /
bṛṃhaṇahetutvaṃ bhūtavṛddhau tadāśritopādāyarūpavṛddheḥ //
pṛthivīdhātur ityādivyākaraṇaṃ -- svalakṣaṇopādāyarūpadhāraṇāt pṛthivyādaya eva dhātavaḥ /
pṛthivyādigrahaṇaṃ cakṣurdhātvādibhyaḥ parasparataś ca vyavacchedārtham /
dhātugrahaṇaṃ laukikebhyaḥ pṛthivyādibhyo viśeṣaṇārtham /
pṛthivyādayo hi laukikaśāstraprasiddhibhedena dvidheṣyante /
tatra laukikā varṇasaṃsthānātmakatvāt sāṃvyavahārikā iti na dhātavaḥ /
śāstrīyāḥ punaḥ khakkhaṭādisvabhāvasadbhāvāt pāramārthikatvād dhātavaḥ /
bhūtavat pṛthivīdhātvādayo 'pi svarūpanirdeśam a[p. 7]ntareṇa na vijñāyanta iti punar api praśnaḥ -- pṛthivīdhātuḥ katama ityādi /
khakkhaṭatvam iti bhāvapratyayo 'tra svārthikaḥ /
khakkhaṭam eva khakkhaṭatvam na hy atra bhāvāntaram asti /
khakkhaṭaḥ kharaḥ krūra itiparyāyāḥ /
sneho 'bdhātur iti saṃśrayātmakatvād dravatvād vā snehaḥ /
dāhakatvād ūṣmā tejodhātuḥ /
vāyudhātur laghusamudīraṇatvam iti /
laghutvaṃ vāyudhātur ity ucyamāna upādāyarūpasyāpi bhūtatvaṃ prasajyeta /
īraṇaṃ vāyudhātur ity ucyamāne karmaivāsya nirdiṣṭaṃ syān na svarūpam ity ato 'sya laghutvād upādāyarūpāt karmaṇaś cavyavacchedārtham evam
uktaṃ laghusamudīraṇatvaṃ vāyudhātur iti /
samudīraṇatvaṃ punar bhāvasrotaso nairantaryeṇa deśāntarotpattihetutvam /
ete ca pṛthivyaptejovāyudhātava upādāyarūpeṇeva parasparato 'py avinirbhāgavartina iti kathaṃ vijñāyate /
karmataḥ /
ata eva caiṣāṃ dhṛtisaṅgrahapaktivyūhanāni kāritram uktam /
kathaṃ nāmaiṣāṃ svarūpato 'nupalabhyamānānām api ,
upalādiṣu kāryataḥ sattvam anumīyeteti /
tathā hy [p. 8] upalādiṣu saṅgrahapaktivyūhanebhyo jalānalānilānāṃ pṛthivīdhātunā sāhacaryaṃ vijñāyate /
apsu kāṣṭhasandhāraṇapatradalapākoṣṇatāvacalanebhyaḥ kṣityanalānilānām abdhātunā /
agnau jvālādīnāṃ sthairyasampiṇḍitapreraṇebhyaḥ kṣitijalānilānāṃ tejasā /
vāyau sandhāraṇavastrādiśoṣaṇāvisārebhyaḥ kṣityudakānalānāṃ vāyudhātunā sāhacaryaṃ vijñāyate /
karmaṇaḥ svabhāvasya ca ko viśeṣaḥ /
kriyamāṇāpekṣaṃ karma vyavasthāpyate /
tathā hy ādhāryadravyasandhāraṇāpekṣayāpṛthivīdhātor dhṛtiḥ karmocyate /
saṅgrāhyāpekṣayāpāṃ saṅgrahaḥ karma ,
pākāpekṣayā tejasaḥ paktiḥ karmavardhanīyakalalāṅkurāpekṣayā vyūhanaṃ vāyoḥ karma /
vyūhanaṃ punar vṛddhiḥ prasarpaṇaṃ ca /
svabhāvas tu sarvānyabhāvanirapekṣa ity ayaṃ karmaṇaḥ svabhāvasya ca viśeṣaḥ /
uktāni bhūtāni sāmānyaviśeṣasañjñābhiḥ svabhāvataś ca //
bhūtānantaroddiṣṭam upādāyarūpaṃ prabhedataḥ svarūpataś ca na vijñāyata ity ataḥ pṛcchati -- upādāyarūpaṃ katamad iti /
katiprakāraṃ [p. 9] kiṃsvarūpaṃ cety arthaḥ /
cakṣurindriyaṃ kiṃsvabhāvam /
varṇaviṣayo rūpaprasāda iti tatsvabhāvāviṣkaraṇam /
catvāri mahābhūtāny upādāyeti prakṛtatvāt sambadhyate /
varṇo nīlapītādikaś catuḥprakāraḥ /
varṇālocanād varṇanirbhāsāsādhāraṇakāraṇatvād vā varṇo viṣayo 'syeti varṇaviṣayaḥ /
ayaṃ cātra prasādārthaḥ ,
tadyathā prasanna ādarśa udakapātre vā bimbaṃ pratītya tatpratibhāsaṃ pratibimbam utpadyate ,
tadvat pañcasu rūpaprasādātmakeṣu cakṣurādiṣu rūpagandhādīn pratītya tatpratibhāsā vijñaptaya utpadyante /
atra cakṣurādīnāṃ parasparato viṣayarūpātmakāt prasādān manastaḥ śraddhātaś ca vyavacchedaḥ kāryaḥ /
rūpaprasādātmakatvāviśeṣād varṇaviṣayatvāviśeṣāc ca ubhayam ucyate varṇaviṣayo rūpaprasāda iti ca /
tatra varṇaviṣayatvena śrotrādibhyo viṣayaprasādāc ca vyavacchinatti /
na hi śrotrādayo viṣayaprasādo vā varṇaviṣayo 'sti /
rūpaprasādātmakatvena manasto vyavacchinatti /
tad dhi saty api varṇaviṣayatve na rūpaprasādātmakam /
rūpagrahaṇaṃ śraddhātmakāt prasādād vyavacchedakam /
śraddhāpi hi prasādātmikā rūpādiviṣayā cety ato rūpagrahaṇam /
varṇaviṣayaḥ prasādaś cakṣurindriyam ity ucyamāne śraddhāyā api prasaṅga ity ato rūpagrahaṇaṃ kriyata iti śraddhāyā arū[p. 10]pātmakatvāt /
cakṣurādīni hi indantītīndriyāṇi /
īśanta ity arthaḥ ādhipatyam asmin saṅghātekurvantīty arthaḥ ,
ataś cādhipatyārtha indriyārthaḥ ,
indantītīndriyāṇi /
evam indrāṇīti prāpnoti /
nipātanād indriyam iha bhaviṣyati /
evam api dhātvartho vaktavyaḥ /
sa ca nokta ityayaṃ parihāraḥ /
vijñānavad eva kṛt syāt /
tadyathā vijānātīti vijñānam iti prāpte lyuḍartham anādṛtya vijñānam uktaṃ tadvyatiriktavijñātṛsaṅgrahavyudāsārtham evam ihāpīndriyavyatiriktaliṅgakalpanāvyudāsārtham
evam uktaṃ syād iti /
yathaiva hi cakṣurādīnāṃ viṣayiṇāṃ parasparato viṣayabhedena bheda uktaḥ -- cakṣurindriyaṃ katamat /
varṇaviṣayo rūpaprasādaḥ /
śrotrendriyaṃ katamat /
śabdaviṣayo rūpaprasāda ity evamādi ,
evaṃ rūpādīnām api viṣayāṇāṃ cakṣurādibhir viṣayibhir bheda ucyate /
cakṣuṣa eva viṣayo rūpam ,
na śrotrādīnām ,
tadviṣayāṇāṃ śabdāditvena vyavasthānāt /
atra ca manaso navidhir na pratiṣedho 'prakṛtatvāt /
evaṃ ca rūpādīnāṃ parasparato bheda ukto bhavati -- cakṣuṣo viṣayo rūpam eva ,
nārūpam iti /
evam api nīlapītādīnāṃ parasparavilakṣaṇānāṃcakṣurindriyaviṣayāṇāṃ rūpatvenābheda ukto bhavatīti /
yadi cakṣurviṣayatvena rūpaṃ viśeṣitam eveti ,
evaṃ sati varṇasaṃsthā[p. 11]naṃ vijñaptiś ceti kimartham /
rūpaprabhedasandarśanārtham /
rūpaprabhedeṣu hi sandigdhaviparyastāvyutpannānāṃ bhedapradarśanena sandehaviparyāsāvyutpattayo nirākriyante /
varṇaścatuḥprakāraḥ /
nīlaḥ pīto lohito 'vadātaśca /
abhraṃ dhūmorajo mahikā cchāyātapa āloko 'ndhakāramabhyavakāśaṃnabhaśceti te 'pi kasmād atra noktāḥ /
varṇasaṃsthānavadrūpabhedatvena noktāḥ /
abhrādayo hi paricchinnadeśāaparicchinnadeśāś ca /
tatra ye paricchinnadeśās te saṃsthāna evāntarbhūtāḥ /
ye 'paricchinnadeśās te varṇaviśeṣā eveti /
na varṇasaṃsthānābhyāṃ pṛthag vyavasthāpayituṃ śakyanta itīhapṛthag noktāḥ /
tatrābhyavakāśastadanyapratighātakartṛspraṣṭavyavirahito yaḥ pradeśaḥ /
na bho yad upariṣṭān nīlam upalabhyate /
saṃsthānaṃ dīrghaṃ hrasvaṃ vṛttaṃ parimaṇḍalam unnatamavanataṃ sātaṃ visātam iti /
kiṃ punar idaṃ saṃsthānaṃ nāma /
nanūktaṃ dīrghādir iti /
tad etad eva na jñāyate /
yatradīrghādibuddhayo bhavanti tad dīrghādisaṃsthānam /
evaṃ tarhi na varṇādivyatiriktaṃ saṃsthānaṃ vidyate /
kiṃ kāraṇam /
[p. 12] yasmād ekadiṅmukhapravṛtte bhūyasi varṇādisaṅghāte dīrghabuddhir bhavati ,
alpīyasi hrasvabuddhiḥ ,
caturdiśaṃ same vṛttabuddhiḥ ,
sarvataḥ same parimaṇḍalabuddhiḥ ,
ekadiṅmukhe sātabuddhiḥ ,
nānādiṅmukhe visātabuddhir iti /
kathaṃ punar etad gamyate -- varṇādisamudāye dīrghabuddhir bhavati na punar arthāntarabhūte saṃsthāna iti /
sparśanadvāreṇāpi dīrghādibuddhyutpatteḥ ,
na cendriyāntaraviṣaya indriyāntaradvāreṇa buddhir utpadyate ,
naikendriyavaiyarthyaprasaṅgāt /
naiva tad indriyajñānam ,
kiṃ tarhy anumānajñānam ,
gandhāt puṣpavarṇajñānavat /
yathā gandhaḥ puṣpavarṇaniyataḥ na tv evaṃ sparśaḥ saṃsthāna iti viṣamo 'yam upanyāsaḥ /
tasmād ubhayendriyadvāreṇa ghaṭādivad dīrghādisaṃsthānapravṛtteḥ na tad varṇādibhyo'rthāntaram iti /
na ca niravayavatvāt paramāṇūnāṃ dīrghādirūpeṇa [p. 13] parasparato bhedo yuktaḥ /
tasmān na nīlādiparamāṇuvad dīrghādiparamāṇavaḥ santīty ataś ca saṃsthānaparamāṇusamudāyo 'pi dīrghādisaṃsthānam ity ayuktam ,
dīrghādisaṃsthānaparamāṇvabhāvāt /
na ca saṃsthānātmakaṃ dravyam ,
arvāṅmadhyaparabhāgasambhavāt /
na ca teṣām abhedaḥ ,
yugapat pratyakṣāpratyakṣatvāt /
sambandhibhedāc catasyāvaśyaṃ bhedena bhavitavyam abhede vātatsambandhīnām apy abhinnatvaprasaṅga iti /
tasmān nāsty eva dravyataḥ saṃsthānam ,
kiṃ tarhi varṇādiṣv eva tathā tathāvyavasthiteṣu dīrghādi prajñapyate //
atha vijñaptir nāma ka eṣa dharmaḥ /
tadālambanacittajaṃ kāyamahābhūtāśrayeṇotpannaṃ kāyasya saṃsthānaṃ svasamutthāpakacittavijñapanād vijñaptir ity ucyate /
atra ca tadālambanād eva yaj jāyate cittāt saṃsthānam tad eva vijñaptiḥ na punar anyālambanāt /
evaṃ ca punar bruvata oṣṭhādisaṃsthānam atadālambanacittajatvān nirākṛtam ,
pūrvapraṇidhānajaṃ ca /
tad dhi praṇidhānacittād anyavipākahetucittajam [p. 14] apīti na vijñaptir iṣyate /
tatra yadi vijñaptyākhyaṃ saṃsthānam ekaṃ kāyākhyasamudāyavyāpi tad ekatvād vyāpitvāc ca pratyavayavaṃ gṛhyate sarvasmiṃs tadbhāvāt /
na vā tad ekam ,
bhāgato vyavasthānāt /
daśa cāyatanāni paramāṇusañcitānīti siddhānto bādhyeta /
tasmān nāsti saṃsthānaṃ nāma dravyāntaram /
ataś ca na saṃsthānaṃvijñaptiḥ /
yadi kāyād arthāntaram ,
na saṃsthānam ,
kā tarhi sā /
tadālambanacetanānimittā kāyasantater nairantaryeṇa deśāntarotpattiḥ /
cetanānimittatvaṃ tu kāyasantater deśāntarotpattihetuvāyudhātunirvartanāt /
sā ca kāyasya deśāntarotpattiḥ svanimittaṃ cetanāṃ vijñāpayatīti vijñaptiḥ /
tasyās tu kuśalākuśalatvaṃ na svābhāvikam /
kiṃ tarhi kuśalākuśalacetanāpravartitatvāt kuśalākuśalatvam upacaryate ,
kārye kāraṇopacārāt /
atra tu rūpavyavasthānaṃ svabhāvataḥ sanniveśataḥ kriyālakṣaṇataś ca /
svabhāvato nīlādīnāṃ caturṇāṃ varṇānām ,
tatsvabhāvatvāt /
sanniveśato daśānāṃ dīrghādisaṃsthānānām ,
tathā tathā varṇasanniveśāt /
kriyālakṣaṇato vijñapteḥ praspandātmakatvāt /
dravyasadviṣayatvāc cakṣurādīnām ,
saṃsthānasya vijñapteś caprajñaptisattvā[p. 15]t na cakṣuṣo viṣayatvam asti /
kathaṃ cakṣurviṣayatvena rūpam ucyate /
atra hi lokānuvṛttyā varṇaḥ saṃsthānaviśeṣaṇaś cakṣurviṣayatvena vivakṣitaḥ /
tathā hi saṃsthānaviśiṣṭaś cakṣuṣā varṇo gṛhyate ,
na kevalaṃ saṃsthānaṃ varṇo vā ,
dīrghādisaṃsthānaviśiṣṭavarṇanirbhāsacakṣurvijñānotpatteḥ /
ato varṇaḥ saṃsthānaṃ ca cakṣuṣo viṣaya iti loke prasiddhiḥ /
tathā deśāntarotpattiviśiṣṭakāyasantatigrahaṇād vijñaptir api cakṣuṣo viṣaya iti prasiddhiḥ /
paramārthatas tu saṃsthānavan na varṇo 'pi cakṣuṣo viṣayaḥ ,
saṃsthānavat paramāṇor aniṣpannatvād vijñānasya bāhyārthāviṣayatvāt /
tasmāl lokaśāstraprasiddhir evātrācāryeṇānuvṛtteti gamyate /
rūpānantaram uddiṣṭatvāt tannirdeśānantaram eva śabdasya nirdeśo nyāyya iti praśnaḥ -- śabdaḥ katamaḥ /
śrotrasya viṣaya iti śrotrasyaiva viṣayonānyasyendriyasyeti /
evaṃ hy upādāyarūpatvāviśeṣe 'pi ,
anyendriyaviṣayebhyo rūpādibhyo 'sya viśeṣa ukto bhavati /
śrotraviṣayaś ca śabda eveti parasparabhinnānāṃ śabdabhedānāṃ śabdāyatanatvenābheda ukto bhavati /
tadbhedapradarśanārtham āha upāttānupāttobhayamahābhūtahetuka iti /
tatropāttāny ātmabhāvaparyāpannāni cittacaittair a[p. 16]dhiṣṭhānabhāvenopagṛhītāni /
viparyayād anupāttāni /
tāni hetur asyety upāttānupāttobhayamahābhūtahetukaḥ /
tatropāttamahābhūtahetuko hastavācchabda ity evamādi /
anupāttamahābhūtahetuko vāyuvanaspatinadīśabda ity evamādi /
ubhayamahābhūtahetuko mṛdaṅgaśabda ity evamādi //
gandhaḥ katamaḥ /
ghrāṇasyaiva viṣayaḥ /
ghrāṇaviṣayaś ca gandha eveti pūrvavat /
samagandhas tu tenendriyamahābhūtānāṃ nānugraho nopaghātaḥ /
sa ca gandhaḥ sahajaḥ sāṃyogikaḥ pāriṇāmikaś ca /
tatra sahajaś candanakuṅkumādīnām /
sāṃyogiko dhūpavartigandhādīnām /
pāriṇāmikaḥ pakvāmraphalādīnām //
rasaḥ katama ityādi /
jihvāyā eva viṣayaḥ ,
jihvāviṣayaś ca rasa eveti pūrvad vistareṇa vaktavyam /
prakṛtibhedāt ṣaḍbheda uktaḥ /
a[p. 17]nyas tu bhedastatsaṃyogabhedāt anantaś ca bhavati //
atra hy upādāyarūpanirdeśaḥ prastutaḥ ,
rasānantaraṃ tu spraṣṭavyaikadeśa upādāyarūpatvenoddiṣṭa ity ato rasanirdeśānantaraṃ spraṣṭavyaikadeśanirdidikṣayā praśnaḥ -- spraṣṭavyaikadeśaḥ
katama iti /
spraṣṭavyaṃ hi dvividham ,
bhūtāni tāni copādāya rūpam /
bhūtāni ca pūrvam uddiṣṭāni nirdiṣṭāni ca /
iha tūpādāyarūpaṃ prakṛtam iti /
ataḥ spraṣṭavyaikadeśaḥ katama upādāyarūpam iti sambadhyate /
kāyasya viṣaya iti kāyasyaiva viṣayo na cakṣurādīnām iti rūpaśabdādibhyo 'sya bheda ukto bhavati /
kāyasya ca viṣayaḥ sparśa eveti bhūtabhautikayoḥ parasparavilakṣaṇatve 'pi sparśatvenābheda ukto bhavati /
kāyasya viṣaya iti bhūtānām api kāyaviṣayatvād upādāyarūpaprasaṅga ity ata āha -- mahābhūtāni sthāpayitveti /
spraṣṭavyaikadeśapradarśanārtham āha -- ślakṣṇatvaṃ karkaśatvam ityādi /
nanu ca kāyendriyeṇa spṛśyata iti ślakṣṇatvādi spraṣṭavyam ucyate /
yac ca yena spṛśyate niyogāt tad api tat spṛśatīti kāyendriye 'pi sparśatvaprasaṅgaḥ /
na hi kenacit kiñcit spṛśyate /
sarvātmanā sparśane hi sarvapiṇḍāḥ paramāṇupramāṇāḥ syuḥ /
pradeśena sparśane paramāṇūnāṃ sāvayavatvaprasaṅgāt paramāṇutvam avahīyate /
tasmād viṣayendriyayor nirantarotpattau yadāśritaṃ vijñānaṃ [p. 18] viṣayamupalabhate tena sa viṣayaḥ spṛṣṭa ity upacaryate na tu viṣayeṇa
ata eva kāyendriyeṇa bhūtāny eva spṛśyanta ity upacaryate ,
na tadāśritā rūpādayaḥ ,
kāyavijñānenāgrahaṇāt /
puṣpādiṣu ca varṇādyupaghātas tadāśrayopaghātāt ,
na kāyasaṃsparśād iti /
varṇādyāśrayasyāpi kāyenāspṛṣṭasya katham upaghāta iti /
cintyam etat /
tasmāl lokavyavahāra evātrānusartavyaḥ ,
na paramārthaḥ /
ślakṣṇatvaṃ mṛdv aparūṣam āliṅganakṣamam ity arthaḥ /
ślakṣṇam eva ślakṣṇatvam /
karkaśatvam iti karkam asyāstīti karkaśam ,
lomaśavat /
karkam iti balasyākhyā /
karkaśam eva karkaśatvam /
rūkṣaṃ paruṣam asukumāram ity arthaḥ /
guruḥsāndra ity arthaḥ /
gurv eva gurutvam /
yena bhāvās tulyante ,
avanamanti /
laghutvaṃ yena bhāvā nāvanamanti /
saṃsthānapṛthutve 'pi yasya sadbhāvāt sukham āhriyate /
tulāyā jaghanāvanatikāraṇam ity arthaḥ /
yadabhyāhatasyoṣṇābhilāṣo bhavati tac chītam /
nanu ca grīṣme śaradi ca saty api śīta uṣṇābhilāṣo na bhavati /
uṣṇābhilāṣasyānyathābhāvāt ,
śītam evoṣṇābhilāṣakṛd ity avadhāryate /
evaṃ ca tatkāryam api tajjātīyatvāl lakṣyate [p. 19] lākṣaṇikaiḥ /
jighatsā bhojanābhilāṣakṛt /
pipāsā pānābhilāṣakṛt /
na hi caitasiko dharmaḥ kāyendriyaviṣayo 'stīti /
ataḥ kāraṇe kāryopacāraṃ kṛtveha nirdeśo jighatsā pipāseti /
vāyudhātubhūyiṣṭho hi kaścit spraṣṭavyaviśeṣo jighatsāhetuḥ koṣṭha utpadyate /
sa jighatsākāraṇatvāj jighatsety uktaḥ /
evaṃ tejodhātubhūyiṣṭhaḥ pipāsākāraṇatvāt pipāsety uktaḥ /
anye 'pi mūrchābaladaurbalyādayaḥ spraṣṭavyaviśeṣā vidyante /
eteṣv evāntarbhutā iti pṛthag noktāḥ /
mūrchā ślakṣṇatvān na bhidyate /
balaṃ karkaśagurutvābhyām /
evam anye 'pispraṣṭavyaviśeṣā yathāsambhavam antarbhāvayitavyāḥ /
ślakṣṇatvādīnāṃ tv āśrayaviśeṣāt parasparato viśeṣaḥ /
aptejodhātūtsadatvācchlakṣṇatvam /
pṛthivīvāyudhātūtsadatvāt karkaśatvam /
pṛthivyabdhātūtsadatvād gurutvam /
tejovāyudhātūtsadatvāl laghutvam /
ata eva mṛtaśarīreṣv adhikaṃ gurutvam /
abdhātūtsadatvāc chītam /
vāyudhātūtsadatvāj jighatsā /
tejodhātūtsadatvāt pipāsā /
evam anyasminn apy upādāyarūpe ya[p. 20]thāsambhavam āśrayaviśeṣāt parasparaviśeṣo 'vagantavya iti /
atra tu diṅmātraṃ pradarśitaṃ granthagauravaparihārārtham iti //
rūpaskandhād upādāyarūpād vāvijñaptir evāvaśiṣyata iti praśnaḥ -- avijñaptiḥ katameti /
tannirdeśaḥ -- vijñaptisamādhijaṃ kuśalākuśalaṃ rūpam anidarśanam apratigham iti /
tatra vijñaptir dvividhā ,
kāyavijñaptir vāgvijñaptiś ca /
sā punaḥ pratyekaṃ tridhā bhidyate ,
kuśalākuśalāvyākṛtabhedāt /
avijñaptir api trividhaiva kāmāptā rūpāptānāsravā ca /
tatra kāmāvacary avijñaptiḥ kuśalākuśalavijñaptijā /
sā punaḥ prātimokṣasaṃvaro bodhisattvasaṃvaro 'saṃvaras tadviyuktā ca /
tatra prātimokṣasaṃvaro bhikṣuśrāmaṇeropāsakopavāsasthabhedād dravyataś caturvidhaḥ /
nāmatas tv aṣṭavidhaḥ bhikṣubhikṣuṇyādibhedāt /
tatra prātimokṣasaṃvaraḥ sanidānāt sarvākārāt paropaghātān nivṛttiḥ /
bodhisattvasaṃvaraḥ kāyajīvitopāttavastunirapekṣaṃ kāyavākcittaiḥ sarvākāraparopakārapravṛttiḥ /
asaṃvaraḥ sarvākāraparopaghāta pravṛttiḥ /
ekade[p. 21]śenānugrahopaghātapravṛttir naiva saṃvaro nāsaṃvaraḥ /
tatra rūpāptānāsravā ca samādhijā /
sā punar yathākramaṃ dhyānasaṃvaro 'nāsravasaṃvaraś ca /
tatra caturṣu dhyāneṣv anāgamye dhyānāntare ca sāsravasamādhijo dhyānasaṃvaraḥ /
anāsravasamādhijo 'nāsravasaṃvaraḥ /
tasyās tūpādāyarūpatvaṃ bhūtāny āśritya pravṛtter anuvṛtteś ca /
idam ihāmutrety ayam eva vyapadeśo nidarśanam /
so 'tra nāstīty anidarśanam /
svapradeśe parasyotpattipratibandhaḥ pratighātaḥ /
sa cāvijñapter adeśatvān na sambhavatīty apratigham /
sarvaṃ hi rūpaṃ trividham /
sanidarśanaṃ sapratigham -- cakṣurindriyaviṣayaḥ /
anidarśanaṃ sapratigham -- cakṣurādayaḥ pañca śabdagandharasasparśāś catvāraḥ ,
anidarśanam apratighaṃ ca dharmāyatanikaṃ rūpam /
tat punaḥ pañcaprakāram -- ābhisaṅkṣepikam ābhyavakāśikaṃ sāmādānikaṃ parikalpitaṃ vaibhūtvikaṃ ceti /
iha tv ekādaśadravya eva rūpaskandho vivakṣita iti sāmādānikam eva rūpam anidarśanam apratigham ity uktam ,
nānyat /
kimarthaṃ punas tan noktam /
ābhisaṅkṣepikaṃ paramāṇava eva nīlādikād varṇān na bhidyante /
na ca [p. 22] varṇanibhā anyā nīlādikād varṇāt /
ābhyavakāśikaṃ paramāṇava eva tadanyapratighātikaspraṣṭavyavirahitāḥ /
te ca varṇātmakatvādihopāttā eveti punar na nirdiṣṭāḥ /
parikalpitaṃ pratibimbarūpam asthisaṅkalikādikam /
vaibhūtvikaṃ vimokṣadhyāyigocaraṃ yad rūpam ,
tad vikalpātmakatvād iha nopāttam /
na hi tat tadākāravijñānapratyavabhāsād bahir vidyate /
pratibimbaṃ ca viṣayapratyavabhāso vijñānasyaiveti na vijñānāt pratibimbaṃ pratibimbād vā vijñānaṃ pṛthag asti /
tasmāt sāmādānikam evoktam ,
nānyat /
ko vā prabhāvamahatām asmadvidho buddhivispanditāny avagāhituṃ samarthaḥ /
tasmāt tadanabhidhāna ācāryābhiprāyo 'nveṣyaḥ /
etad uktaṃ bhavati vijñaptisamādhisambhūtaṃ kuśalākuśalam upādāyarūpam vikṣiptāvikṣiptacittasyācittasya ca yad anubadhnāti ,
tat parityāgakāraṇābhāve uktaṃ bhavati -- avijñaptir iti /
rūpakriyāsvabhāvāpi satī svasamutthāpakaṃ cittaṃ vijñaptivat paraṃ na vijñapayatīty avijñaptiḥ /
atra ca vaibhāṣikaparikalpitavijñaptivad avijñaptir api naivāsti ,
pramāṇā[p. 23]viṣayatvāt /
na ca prātimokṣasaṃvarādyabhāvaḥ /
tathā hi yayā cetanayākṛtābhyupagama upasampadādividhānapūrvakaṃ pratiṣiddhāt karmaṇaḥ kāyavācau saṃvṛṇoti ,
tayā cetanayālayavijñāne 'nāgatatajjātīyacetanotpattaye bījam āhitam ,
yata uttarakālam ahaṃ prāṇātipātādibhyaḥ prativirata iti samādānasmṛtir utpadyate /
tasyāṃ samutpannāyāṃ yo lajjī na sa śikṣāṃ bhinatti /
evaṃ ca sānubandhā samādānacetanā saṃvara ity uktaṃ bhavati /
tathā dhyānaṃ mārgaṃ vā samāpanno vināpy avijñaptyā tadrūpaṃ mārgam āśrayaṃ ca pratilabhate ,
yasya pratilambhād vyutthito 'pi na punar mithyāvāgādiṣu pravartate ,
saṃyagvāgādiṣv eva pravartate /
ato nimitte naimittikopacāraṃ kṛtvā ,
aṣṭau mārgāṅgāni dhyānasaṃvaraś ca vyavasthāpyate /
asaṃvaro 'pi vadhakaprayogakriyācetanā tatkulīnānām ,
tatkarmābhyupagamacetanā 'nyakulīnānām /
na ca taccetanāpagame 'samvaratyāgaḥ ,
sattveṣu drohāśayasyāvinivṛttatvāt /
evaṃ ca kriyācetanābhyupagamacetanā ca sattveṣu drohāśayānugatāsaṃvara ity uktaṃ bhavati /
atra ca vijñaptisamādhijatvaṃ subodham eveti na punar iha prapañcitam /
kuśalākuśalatvaṃ tu saṃvarāsaṃvaracetanānāṃ svata eva ,
ta[p. 24]danubandhasya kuśalākuśalacetanākṣiptatvāt kuśalākuśalacetanāphalatvāc ca /
dhyānānāsravasaṃvarayor api dhyānānāsravamārganimittatvāt saṃyagvāgādiphalatvāc ca kuśalatvam /
rūpatvaṃ punaḥ kāyavāgviṣayatvāt ,
viṣayiṇi viṣayopacārāt /
anidarśanāpratighatvaṃ tu subodham iti //
kasmāt punar ayam avijñaptiparyanto rūpaskandho rūpam ity ucyate /
uktaṃ hi bhagavatā -- rūpyate rūpyata iti bhikṣavas tasmād rūpopādānaskandhaity ucyate /
kena rūpyate /
pāṇisaṃsparśenāpi spṛṣṭo rūpyata iti vistaraḥ /
sūtre hi -- pāṇyādisaṃsparśena rūpaṇād rūpam ity uktam /
kā punar iyaṃ rūpasya rūpaṇā /
hastādisaṃsparśanapūrvāvasthāto'nyathotpādanā /
iyaṃ ca santānam adhikṛtyocyate ,
na kṣaṇam /
kṣaṇasyotpādavināśakālayor adhikṛtatvāt //
rūpaskandhānantaraṃ vedanāskandhanirdeśāvasaras tadanantaram uddiṣṭatvād iti praśnaḥ -- vedanā katameti /
trividho 'nubhava iti nirdeśaḥ /
anubhūtir anubhavo vastuno hlādaparitāpatadubhayākāravinirmuktasvarū[p. 25]pasākṣātkaraṇaḥ /
atha vā hlādaparitāpobhayākāravinirmuktaṃ vastusvarūpam anubhavatīty anubhavaḥ /
sa ca svabhāvabhedāt trividhaḥ ,
sukho duḥkho 'duḥkhāsukhaś ca /
kathaṃ punaḥ sukhaduḥkhavyatirikto 'nyas tṛtīyo 'nubhavo 'stīti vijñāyate /
āgamād yuktitaś ca /
uktaṃ hi sūtre -- "tisro vedanā" iti /
punaś coktam -- sukhasya ca prahāṇād duḥkhasya ca prahāṇād aduḥkhāsukhasya ceti /
yuktir api vedanāvirahitacittotpattyabhāvād apetasukhaduḥkhacittopalabdheś ceti /
vedanānubhavaḥ sparśasyety ācāryasaṅghabhadraḥ /
iṣṭāniṣṭobhayaviparītānāṃ sparśānām anubhavaḥ sā vedanā /
tathā coktam -- sukhavedanīyaṃ sparśaṃ pratītyotpadyate sukhā vedanetivistaraḥ /
sukhavedanādijanakatvena tadvibhaktatvāt /
yadi ca viṣayānubhavo vedanā syāt ,
ekālambanebhyo 'sya ko viśeṣaḥ syāt /
yena sparśānubhavo vedaneti vyavasthāpyate /
evaṃ tarhi sañjñādhimokṣasmṛtiprajñādīnām ālambanadvārako vedanāvat svabhāvo na vaktavyaḥ /
athaikālambanebhyo nimittodgrahaṇādibhiḥ sañjñādīnāṃ viśeṣa ucyate vedanāyā viṣayānubhavena kiṃ neṣyate /
sparśānubhavaś ca tatsamprayogaḥ kāraṇabhāvo vā parikalpyeta ,
tadālambanatvāsambhavāt /
tatra na bhavet samprayogaḥ ,
sarvacaittānāṃ sparśasamprayogāviśeṣāt /
nāpi kāraṇabhāvaḥ ,
sarvacaittānāṃ sparśasya kāraṇatvāviśeṣāt /
na ca loke śāstre vānubhavaśabdaḥ kārye kāraṇe vā prasiddhaḥ /[p. 26] prasiddhas tu sākṣātkāre /
evaṃ tu manyante -- śubhāśubhānāṃ karmaṇāṃ phalavipākaṃ pratyanubhavanty anenety anubhavaḥ /
tatra śubhānāṃ karmaṇāṃ sukho 'nubhavaḥ phalavipākaḥ /
aśubhānāṃ duḥkhaḥ /
ubhayeṣām aduḥkhāsukhaḥ /
atra cālayavijñānam eva śubhāśubhakarmavipākaḥ /
tatsamprayuktaivopekṣā paramārthataḥ śubhāśubhānāṃ karmaṇāṃ vipākaḥ /
sukhaduḥkhayos tu vipākajatvād vipākopacāraḥ /
tatra sukho 'nubhavo yasya nirodha ityādi /
yat tarhy uktaṃ pratītyasamutpāde -- yasyām utpannāyām aviyogecchā jāyate sā sukhā vedaneti ,
tat katham /
nāsty atra virodhaḥ ,
arthata itaropādānāt /
yasyām utpannāyām aviyogecchā jāyata ity arthata uktaṃ bhavati -- tasyāṃ niruddhāyāṃ punaḥ saṃyogecchāpi bhavatīti /
yasya nirodhe saṃyogacchando bhavatīty atrāpy arthata [p. 27]uktam bhavati -- tasyotpāde 'viyogacchando bhavati /
yat tarhy anicchopagatarāgaparyavasthānānāṃ yatīnāṃ rāgaje sukha utpanne viyogecchā jāyate nirodhe cāsaṃyogacchandaḥ ,
tat katham /
nāsau tata eva jāyate ,
tadvidūṣaṇāt /
śīlasamādhiparipanthitvaṃ tasya sukhasya paśyatāṃ tadubhayaṃ bhavatīti nāsti virodhaḥ /
duḥkho yasyotpāde viyogacchanda iti nirodhe ca punar asaṃyogacchandaḥ /
viyogas taducchedaḥ /
chando 'bhilāṣaḥ prārthanā /
duḥkhāsukho yasyotpāda ubhayaṃ na bhavatītyādi /
tatra kāyacittopacayapravṛttatvān manojñasvabhāvatvāc ca sukho 'nubhava iti nirodhe punas tatsaṃyogābhilāṣaḥ pravartate /
kāyacittāpacayapravṛttatvāsvabhāvataś ca pratikūlo duḥkho'nubhava iti tasyotpādetadviyogacchando bhavati /
yas tu nobhayapravṛtto 'sti ca ,
so'nubhavo 'duḥkhāsukhaḥ ,
akṛṣṇāśuklakarmavat /
ata eva cānanugrahānupaghātapravṛttatvāt tadaduḥkhāsukhotpāda ubhayecchābhāvaḥ //
[p. 28] eṣa tu trividho 'nubhavaḥ pratyekam āśrayabhedāt punaḥ ṣaḍvidho bhavati ,
cakṣuḥśrotraghrāṇarasanakāyamanaḥsaṃsparśajatvāt //
punar ādheyasaṅkalanato dvidhā bhidyate ,
kāyikaś caitasikaśceti /
tatra kāyāvinirbhāvavartitvāt sapratighatvāc cakṣuḥśrotraghrāṇarasanendriyāṇi kāye 'ntarbhāvyakāyaśabdenoktānīty ataś cakṣuḥśrotraghrāṇarasanakāyasaṃsparśānubhavaḥ
kāyika ity uktaḥ /
manaḥsaṃsparśajas tu caitasika ity ukto manomātrāśrayatvāt //
punaḥ vipakṣapratipakṣabhedena pratyekam anubhavasya dvidhā vyavasthānam -- sāmiṣo nirāmiṣa iti ,
gredhāśrito naiṣkramyāśritaś ceti /
āmiṣa rātmabhāvatṛṣṇā /
ātmabhāva ādhyātmikā upādānaskandhāḥ /
tasmiṃs tṛṣṇāpriyaikaputropagūḍhanyāyenāviyogam ivecchantī yā pravartate sā āmiṣam /
tayā saha vartata iti sāmiṣā /
tayā tṛṣṇayā visaṃyuktā viyogānukūlā ca nirāmiṣā /
pañceṣṭā rūpādayaḥ kāmaguṇāḥ /
apekṣābhiṣvaṅgaprārthanālakṣaṇena kāmena guṇyante punaḥ punar abhyasyanta iti kāmaguṇāḥ /
teṣv abhiṣvaṅgaḥ prārthanā ca gredhaḥ /
tadāśritas tena [p. 29] vāśrito gredhāśritaḥ /
naiṣkramyaṃ kāmavairāgyaṃ tanmārgo vā /
tadāśritas tena vāśrito naiṣkramyāśritaḥ /
tatra satkāyavairāgyaṃ purodhāya vipakṣapratipakṣabhāvena sāmiṣanirāmiṣayor vyavasthānam /
laukikavairāgyam adhikṛtya gredhanaiṣkramyāśritavyavasthānam /
kimarthaṃ punar atra svarūpata eva bheda ukto nāśrayādibhedena yathānyatra /
iha saṅkṣepasya vivakṣitatvāt sarvabhedānāṃ ca svarūpād apṛthaktvād āśrayādibhedena nokta iti //
vedanāskandhanirdeśānantaraṃ sañjñāskandhanirdeśāvasara ity ataḥ praśnaḥ -- sañjñā katameti /
viṣayanimittodgrahaṇam iti tannirdeśaḥ /
viṣaya ālambanam /
nimittaṃ viṣayaviśeṣaḥ ,
nīlapītādyālambanavyavasthākāraṇam /
tasyodgrahaṇaṃ nīlanirūpaṇaṃ -- nīlam etat ,
pītam etad iti /
evaṃ tarhi cakṣurādivijñānasamprayuktā sañjñā viṣayanimittodgrahaṇātmikā na syāt ,
viśeṣāsaṃlakṣaṇāt /
sāpi nimittodgrahaṇātmikaiva na paricchedikā mandatvāt /
anyathā pūrvam agṛhīte viśeṣe paścād api nirūpaṇaṃ na syāt -- nīlametat pītam etad iti /
svarūpābhede 'pi bhedaḥ sañjñāyā āśrayata ālambanataś ca ve[p. 30]ditavyaḥ /
āśrayataḥ ṣaṭ sañjñākāyāḥ -- cakṣuḥsaṃsparśajā sañjñā ,
evaṃ yāvan manaḥsaṃsparśajā sañjñā /
ālambanaṃ punaḥ sanimittam ,
animittam parīttam ,
mahadgatam ,
apramāṇam ,
ākiñcanyāyatanaṃ ca /
tatra śabdadvāreṇa yad artharūpam adhyāropitam tena nimittena vastusvarūpaṃ sanimittam /
tasmin vastuny adhyāropitaṃ rūpam etac chabdo 'sāv iti yā sañjñā sā sanimittālambanā /
animittaṃ punar anadhyāropitākāraṃ vastusvarūpam nirvāṇam bhavāgraṃ ca /
tatrādhyāropitanimittābhāvād rūpavedanānimittābhāvād apaṭutvāc caitat trayam animittam ucyate /
avyutpannaśabdārthasambandhasya hi rūpasvarūpa eva sañjñā bhavati ,
na tu rūpam iti /
atas tadviṣayasañjñā animittālambanā /
nirvāṇadhātur api sarvasaṃskṛtanimittapratyastamitasvarūpa iti tadālambanenāpi samādhinā samprayuktā sañjñā animittālambanā /
bhavāgram apaṭutvād animittam /
tatsamāpannasya sañjñālambanaṃ na nimittīkarotīty animittālambanā /
bhavāgrasyātrāsphuṭanimittatvāt tadālambanam animittam ucyate 'nuda[p. 31] rākanyānyāyena ,
na punas tatra nimittaṃ naivāstīty animittam /
anyathā sañjñābhāvaprasaṅga iti ,
nimittābhāve nimittodgrahaṇābhāvāt /
parīttaṃ kāmadhātur ,
nikṛṣṭatvāt /
mahadgato rūpadhātuḥ ,
utkṛṣṭatvāt /
apramāṇe ākāśavijñānānantyāyatane ,
aparyantatvāt /
parigrahakiñcanābhāvād ākiñcanyāyatanam ākiñcanyam /
tasmāt kāmadhātvādyālambanā sañjñā parīttādisañjñety ucyate //
sañjñāskandhanirdeśānantaraṃ saṃskāraskandhanirdeśo nyāyyas tadanantaram uddiṣṭatvād ity ataḥ praśnaḥ -- saṃskārāḥ katame iti /
vedanāsañjñābhyām anye caitasikā dharmāś cittaviprayuktāś ceti tannirdeśaḥ /
sametya sambhūya pratyayaiḥ kṛtatvāt sarva eva rūpādiskandhasaṅgṛhītā dharmāḥ saṃskārā ity ucyante /
iha tu saṃskāraskandhasaṅgṛhītā eva saṃskārā abhipretāḥ /
rūpavedanāsañjñāsaṅgṛhītānām uktatvād vijñānaskandhasaṅgṛhītānāṃ ca vakṣyamāṇatvāt /
ata eva vedanāsañjñayoḥ sparśamanaskārādibhiś caitasikatvāviśeṣe 'py āha -- vedanāsañjñābhyām anye caitasikā iti /
vedanāsañjñayoś caitasikatve saty api vedanāsañjñāskandhasaṅgṛhītatvān na saṃskāraskandhe 'sti saṅgraha iti pradarśanārtham /
vedanā hy upabhogavastu /
tathā hi vedanayā śubhāśubhānāṃ karmaṇāṃ phalavipākam anubhavati /
sañjñā vyavahārava[p. 32]stu /
sañjñayā hi dṛṣṭaśrutamatavijñāteṣv artheṣu nimittam udgṛhya dṛṣṭādiṣu dṛṣṭaśrutamatavijñātā iti lokaḥ saṃvyavahāre pravartate -- ity ato vedanāsañjñe
pṛthakskandhīkṛte ,
nānye caitasikā iti /
yadi vedanāsañjñābhyām anye sparśādayo vicārāntāś caitasikā dharmāś cittaviprayuktāś ca prāptyādayaḥ saṃskāraskandhasaṅgṛhītāḥ ,
evaṃ sati sūtravirodhaḥ /
uktaṃ hi sūtre -- saṃskāraskandhaḥ katamaḥ /
ṣaṭ cetanākāyā iti /
nāsti virodhaḥ ,
prādhānyena tannirdeśāt /
cetanā hi cittābhisaṃskaraṇe pradhānam ,
anuvartante manaskārādaya -- iti cetanaiva saṃskāraskandhatvenoktā /
tathā hi kuśale cittaṃ prerayaty akuśale 'py avyākṛte 'pi sukhaduḥkhādyavasthāsv api cittaṃ prerayatīti /
saṃskāravac caitasikā api dharmā na vijñāyanta iti praśnaḥ /
ye dharmāś cittena samprayuktā iti vyākaraṇam /
te tu na vijñāyanta ity ataḥ pṛcchati /
vyākaraṇaṃ sparśo manaskāra iti vistaraḥ /
ete 'pi sparśādayo vicārāntāḥ pañcabhir āśrayālambanākārakāladravyasamatāprakāraiś cittānuvartanāt samaṃ prayuktā iti samprayuktāḥ /
cittena samprayuktā ity aviśeṣābhidhānāt sarveṣāṃ sarvacittasamprayogaḥ prasakta iti tannirdhāraṇārtham āha -- eṣāṃ pañca sarvatragāḥ ,
pañca pratiniyataviṣa[p. 33]yāḥ ,
ekādaśa kuśalāḥ ,
ṣaṭ kleśāḥ ,
avaśiṣṭā upakleśāḥ ,
kaukṛtyādyāś catvāro 'nyathāpīti /
eṣāṃ ya ādyāḥ sparśo manaskāro vedanā sañjñā cetanā ca ,
ete sarvatragāḥ /
ete hi pañca dharmāḥ sarvaṃ cittam anugacchantīti sarvatragaḥ /
tathā hy ete kuśalena traidhātukenānāsraveṇa ca samprayujyante /
akuśalena kāmāptena kliṣṭāvyākṛtābhyāṃ ca traidhātukābhyāṃ samprayujyante /
avaśyaṃ hi sarvacittapravṛttiṣu trikasannipātena bhavitavyam ,
trikasannipātaś ca sparśāvyabhicārīty ataḥ sparśasya sarvatragatvam /
nirābhogasya cittasyālambane pravṛttyabhāvān manaskāro 'pi sarvatragaḥ /
niranubhavasya nimittodgrahaṇanirapekṣasya ca cittasyābhāvād vedanāsañjñayor api sarvatragatvam /
cetanā tu manaskarmaiveti tayāpy avaśyaṃ sarvatra cetasi bhavitavyam -- ity ata ete pañca dharmāḥ sarvatragāḥ //
pañca pratiniyataviṣayā iti pratiniyato viṣaya eṣāṃ na sarva iti pratiniyataviṣayāḥ /
te punaś chando 'dhimokṣaḥ smṛtiḥ samādhiḥ prajñā /
ekādaśa kuśalāḥ /
te punaḥ śraddhādayo 'vihiṃsāvasānāḥ /
ete hy āśraddhyādivipakṣatvāt kuśalamūlasamprayogāc ca kuśalāḥ /
etair eva ca samprayuktaṃ cittaṃ kuśalam /
ṣaṭ kleśāḥ -- rāgaḥ pratigho māno 'vidyā [p. 34] dṛṣṭir vicikitsā ca /
ete hi cittaṃ kliśnantīti kleśāḥ /
avaśiṣṭā upakleśāḥ /
te punaḥ krodhādyā asamprajanyāntāḥ /
kaukṛtyādyāś catvāro 'nyatheti vacanād upakleśā avaśiṣṭā ity aviśeṣābhidhāne 'py asamprajanyāvasānā eveti gamyate /
kleśāṅgikatvāc cittakleśakaratvāc ca kleśasamīpe vartanta ity upakleśāḥ /
kaukṛtyādyāś catvāra iti kaukṛtyaṃ middhaṃ vitarko vicāraś ca /
anyathāpīti na kevalam ete upakleśā eva ,
kiṃ tarhi kuśalā apy avyākṛtā apīti /
sa eṣa caitasikānāṃ piṇḍaḥ samāsata ekapañcāśad bhavati //
eṣāṃ tu pratyekaṃ svarūpaṃ na prajñāyata iti praśnaḥ -- sparśaḥ katamaḥ ,
manaskāraḥ katama ityādi /
iha caitasikānāṃ lakṣaṇata eva nirdeśo na karmato yathānyatra ,
saṅkṣepasya vivakṣitatvāt /
vayaṃ tu karmāpy eṣāṃ nirdekṣyāmaḥ sukhāvabodhārtham /
tatra pūrvaṃ svarūpam eva nirdiṣṭam ,
prāguddiṣṭatvāt /
evam anyatrāpi yathāsambhavaṃ vācyam /
trikasamavāyapariccheda iti prakṛtam indriyaviṣayavijñānāni trīṇy eva trikam /
tasya kāryakāraṇabhāvena samavasthānaṃ samavāyaḥ /
tasmin sati tatkālam evendriyasya sukhādivedanotpattyanukūlo yo vikāraḥ ,
tena sadṛśo viṣayasya sukhādivedanīyākāraparicchedo yaḥ sa sparśaḥ /
indriyaṃ punar [p. 35] yena viśeṣeṇa sukhaduḥkhādihetutvaṃ pratipadyate sa tasya vikāra indriyavikāraḥ /
sādṛśyenendriyaṃ spṛśatīndriyeṇa vā spṛśyata iti sparśaḥ /
vedanāsanniśrayatvam asya karma /
evaṃ hy uktaṃ sūtre -- sukhavedanīyaṃ sparśaṃ pratītyotpadyate sukhā vedaneti //
manaskāraḥ katamaḥ /
cetasa ābhoga iti /
ābhujanam ābhoga /
ālambane yena cittam abhimukhīkriyate ,
sa cittasyābhogaḥ /
sa punar ālambane cittadhāraṇakarmakaḥ /
cittadhāraṇaṃ punas tatraivālambane punaḥ punaścittasyāvarjanam /
etac ca karma cittasantater ālambananiyamena viśiṣṭaṃ manaskāram adhikṛtyoktam ,
na tu yaḥ praticittakṣaṇam /
yad apy atra nidarśanam ucyate -- samādhilābhī manaskāralābhīty ucyata iti ,
tatra viśiṣṭamanaskāralābhād eva manaskāralābhīty ucyate /
anyathā hi sarvasattvā eva manaskāralābhinaḥ syuḥ ,
sarveṣāṃ praticittakṣaṇaṃ manaskārabhāvāt //
cetanā katamā /
guṇato doṣato nobhayataś cittābhisaṃskāro manaskarmeti /
guṇataḥ kuśaleṣu dharmeṣu /
doṣato 'kuśaleṣu /
anubhaya[p. 36]to 'vyākṛteṣu /
atha vā guṇata ity upakariṣu ,
doṣata ity apakāriṣu ,
anubhayata iti madhyastheṣu /
cittābhisaṃskāra iti manaśceṣṭā /
yasyāṃ satyām ālambanaṃ prati cetasaḥ praspando bhavati ,
ayaskāntavaśād ayaspraspandavat /
āha ca -- kṣaṇāntarānavasthānaṃ nirvyāpāraṃ yayā manaḥ /
savyāpāram ivākhyāti sā manaskarma cetanā //
iti /
cittābhisaṃskāra ity ukte manaskarmeti kimartham /
sarvair eva caitasikaiś cittam abhisaṃskriyate /
tebhyo vyavacchedārthaṃ manaskarmety āha ,
vijñānasya parispandaiva yo dharmaḥ ,
sa eva cetanā nānya iti jñāpanārtham /
guṇato doṣato 'nubhayataś cittābhisaṃskāra iti karmanirdeśaḥ /
manaskarmeti cetanāyāḥ svarūpanirdeśaḥ //
chandaḥ katamaḥ /
abhiprete vastuny abhilāṣa ity /
abhipretagrahaṇam anabhiprete chandābhāvajñāpanārtham /
evaṃ ca cchandasya pratiniyataviṣayatvaṃ jñāpitam bhavati /
darśanaśravaṇādikriyāviṣayatvena yad abhimataṃ vastu tad abhipretam /
tatra darśanaśravaṇābhilāṣaḥ prārthanā /
yady abhilāṣātmakaś chandaḥ ,
tṛṣṇāchandayoḥ kaḥ prativiśeṣaḥ /
tṛṣṇā[p. 37]abhiṣvaṅgalakṣaṇā /
chando 'bhilāṣalakṣaṇa ity asti viśeṣaḥ /
sa ca vīryārambhasanniśrayadānakarmakaḥ ///
adhimokṣaḥ katamaḥ /
niścite vastuni tathaivāvadhāraṇam iti niścitagrahaṇam /
adhimokṣasya sarvaviṣayāsattvaprajñāpanārtham /
na hy aniścite vastuni tathaivāvadhāraṇasambhavo 'stīti /
yuktita āptopadeśād vā yad vastu niḥsandigdhaṃ tan niścitam /
yenaivākāreṇa tan niścitam anityaduḥkhādyākāreṇa ,
tenaivākāreṇa tadvastunaś cetasi niveśanam evam evaitan nānyathety avadhāraṇam adhimokṣaḥ /
sa cāsaṃhāryatākarmakaḥ /
adhimuktipradhāno hi svasiddhāntāt parapravādibhir apahartuṃ na śakyate /
smṛtiḥ katamā /
saṃstute vastuny asampramoṣaś cetaso 'bhilapanateti /
saṃstuta ity asaṃstute smṛtyabhāvapradarśanārtham /
saṃstutaṃ ca vastu pūrvānubhūtam /
asampramoṣa ālambanagrahaṇāvipraṇāśakāraṇam /
tat pūrvagṛhītasya vastunaḥ punaḥ punar ālambanākārasmaraṇam abhilapanatā /
abhilapanam [p. 38] ivābhilapanam ,
abhilapanam evābhilapanatā /
sā punar ālambanābhilapane sati na cittasyālambanāntare ākārāntare vā vikṣepo bhavatīty ato 'vikṣepakarmikā //
samādhiḥ katamaḥ /
upaparīkṣye vastuni cittasyaikāgrateti /
upaparīkṣya iti nānyatra /
evaṃ ca samādheḥ pratiniyataviṣayatvam uktaṃ bhavati /
upaparīkṣye vastuni guṇato doṣato vā /
cittasyaikāgrateti ekālambanatā /
agraṃ hy atrālambanam ucyate /
ñānasanniśrayadānakarmakaḥ ,
samāhite citte yathābhūtaparijñānāt /
upaparīkṣyaṃ vastu satyacatuṣṭayam /
guṇato nirodhasatyaṃ mārgasatyaṃ ca /
nirodhasatyaṃ śāntādyākārair upaparīkṣyam /
mārgasatyaṃ nairyāṇikādyākāraiḥ /
duḥkhasamudayasatye doṣataḥ /
duḥkham anityādyākāraiḥ ,
hetvādyākāraiḥ samudayaḥ /
tathā navānāṃ bhūmīnām adharāṃ doṣataḥ ,
ūrdhvāṃ guṇataḥ /
evam anyeṣv api sāmānyālambaneṣu yathāsambhavaṃ vaktavyam //
prajñā katamā /
tatraiva pravicayo yogāyogavihito 'nyathā ceti /
tatraivety upaparīkṣya eva vastuni /
evaṃ ca samādhivat prajñāpi [p. 39] pratiniyataviṣayety uktaṃ bhavati /
pravicinotīti pravicayaḥ /
saṃyag mithyā vā saṅkīrṇasvasāmānyalakṣaṇeṣv iva dharmeṣu vivekāvabodhaḥ /
yuktir yogaḥ -- āptopadeśo 'numānam pratyakṣaṃ ca /
tena triprakāreṇa yo janitaḥ sa yogavihitaḥ /
sa punaḥ śrutamayaś cintāmayo bhāvanāmayaś ca /
tatrāptavacanaprāmāṇyajo 'vabodhaḥ śrutamayaḥ /
yuktinidhyānajaś cintāmayaḥ /
samādhijo bhāvanāmayaḥ /
ayogaḥ punar anāptopadeśo 'numānābhāsomithyāpraṇihitaś ca samādhiḥ /
tena yo janitaḥ so 'yogavihitaḥ /
tatra sāṅkhyavaiśeṣikādīnāṃ śrutamayaś cintāmayaś cānāptopadeśajanitatvāt kutarkajanitatvād ayogavihitaḥ /
vītarāgānāṃ tu śāśvatocchedavādinām ekatyaśāśvatikādīnāṃ ca mithyāpraṇihitasamādhijanitatvād ayogavihitaḥ /
upapattipratilambhiko laukikavyavahārāvabodhaś ca naiva yogavihito nāyogavihitaḥ /
eṣa ca saṃśayavyāvartanakarmakaḥ /
saṃśayavyāvartanaṃ tu prajñayā dharmān pravicinvato niścayalābhāt //
[p. 40] śraddhā katamā /
karmaphalasatyaratneṣv abhisampratyayo 'bhilāṣaś cetasaḥ prasāda iti /
karma trividham ,
puṇyam apuṇyam āniñjyaṃ ca /
tatrāpuṇyaṃ kāmāptam eva ,
akuśalamūlasamprayogāt /
puṇyam api vipākaniyamāt kāmāptam eva /
karmavipākaṃ praty aniñjanād āniñjyam /
apuṇyasya kāmadhātāv aniṣṭo vipākaḥ ,
puṇyasyeṣṭaḥ /
aniñjasya rūpārūpadhātvor iṣṭa eva vipākaḥ /
tatra karmaphalayor astīty abhisampratyayākārā śraddhā /
asti kuśalam akuśalaṃ ca karma ,
tac ca yathākramam iṣṭāniṣṭaphalam ,
tad api kuśalākuśalakarmahetukam ,
neśvarādinirmitam iti ya evaṃ karmaphalasvarūpe 'viparīte ca karmaphalavipākayor hetuphalasambandhe 'bhisampratyayaḥ ,
iyaṃ karmaphalayor astitvasampratyayākārā śraddhā /
duḥkhasamudayanirodhamārgāḥ satyāni /
āryāṇāṃ pratikūlatvād anityatvāditvenāvitathatvāc ca phalabhūtāḥ pañcopādānaskandhā duḥkhasatyam /
duḥkhahetutvāt pratyayādyākāraiś cāviparītatvād dhetubhūtās ta eva pañcopādānaskandhāḥ samudayasatyam /
sahetukaduḥkhopaśamātmakatvāc chāntādyākārāviparītatvāc ca duḥkhanirodho nirodhasatyam /
duḥkhanirodhaprāpakatvān nairyā[p. 41]ṇikatvādināvitathatvāc cāryāṣṭāṅgamārgo mārgasatyam /
tatra duḥkhasamudayasatyayor asti duḥkham asti samudaya ity abhisampratyayākāraiva śraddhā /
nirodhamārgasatyayor abhilāṣākārā śraddhā ,
śakyo mayā prāptuṃ nirodho mārgaś cotpādayitum iti //
ratnāni trīṇi buddhadharmasaṅghāḥ /
durlabhatvān mahārghatvāt prītikaratvād upakārakaratvād amānuṣādyupaghātapratipakṣatvāc ca ratnānīva ratnāni /
tatra durlabhatvaṃ -- bhavabhogeṣv asaktaiḥ kāyajīvitanirapekṣair bodhisattvair nairantaryeṇa bodhisambhāreṣu pravartamānais tribhiḥ kalpāsaṅkhyeyair
buddhatvaṃ prāpyata iti durlabham /
ata evodumbarapuṣpaprādurbhāvavad durlabho buddhotpāda ucyate /
buddhotpādasya ca durlabhatvād dharmasaṅgharatnayor api durlabhatvaṃ buddhotpādapratibaddhatvāt /
mahārghatvaṃ punaḥ prāptaprakāmaprakarṣāvasthaiḥ puṇyajñānobhayasambhāraiḥ prāpyatvāt /
tatra puṇyasambhāro dānaśīlakṣāntipāramitās tisraḥ /
jñānasambhāraḥ prajñādhyānapāramite /
puṇyajñā nasambhārāṅgabhāvagamanād vīryapāramitobhayasambhāraḥ /
dharmaratnam api sarvasaṃskṛtaparityāgena prāpyatvāt mahārgham /
saṅgharatnam api sāṃsārikaphalanirvartakaviśiṣṭābhyāṃ puṇyajñānābhyāṃ prāpyata iti mahārgham /
ratnatrayaṃ hi darśanaśravaṇānusmaranaiḥ prītihetutvāt prītikaram /
tathābhigamanādhyupāsanānveṣaṇaparijñānaiḥ sattvānām upakārakaram /
yathoktam [p. 42] śrīkaraṃ te 'bhigamanam śaṅkaram adhyupāsanam /
anveṣaṇaṃ matikaram parijñānaṃ viśodhanam //
iti /
amānuṣādyupaghātapraśamanaṃ punar yathoktaṃ sūtre -- saced bho bhikṣavo 'raṇyagatānāṃ veti vistareṇa yāvad yat tad bhaviṣyati bhayaṃ vā chambhitatvaṃ
vā romaharṣo vā tat pratigamiṣyatīti /
evaṃ dharmaratnānusmaraṇe saṅgharatnānusmaraṇe ca vaktavyam /
tatra sarvasmiñ jñeye'saktāpratihatajñānaśaktilābhād āśrayaparāvṛttir buddhaḥ /
sā punaḥ sarvasāsravadharmabījāpagatā sarvānāsravadharmabījapracitā ,
anantaprabhāvaparigrahā cintāmaṇiratnavad anābhogenāśeṣasattvārthakaraṇasamartheti //
dharmas trividhaḥ /
deśanādharmaḥ sūtrageyādikaḥ /
pratipattidharma āryāṣṭāṅgo mārgaḥ sopacāraḥ /
paramārthadharmo nirvāṇam /
sa ca dviprakāraḥ -- sopadhiśeṣo nirupadhiśeṣaś ca /
tatra kleśavisaṃyogākhyaḥ sopadhiśeṣaḥ /
vartamānajanmanirodhe 'nāgatajanmānutpādo nirūpadhiśeṣaḥ //
aṣṭau puruṣapudgalāḥ saṅghaḥ -- catvāraḥ pratipannāś catvāraśca phalasthāḥ /
parasparataḥ śāstṛtaś cābhedyārthena saṅghaḥ /
sarvaguṇadoṣaprakarṣā[p. 43]pakarṣaniṣṭhāgatatvād buddhe bhagavati romāñcāśrupātādisūcitā prasādalakṣaṇā śraddhā /
sarvasahetukaduḥkhopaśamātmakatvāt prāpakatvāttaddyotakatvāc ca dharme prasādalakṣanaiva śraddhā /
saṃsārapaṅkottīrnatvāt saṃsārapaṅkottaraṇamārgāvasthitatvācca saṅghe 'pi prasādātmikaiva //
śraddhā hi trividhā pravartate /
sati vastuni guṇavaty aguṇavati vā sampratyayākārā ,
sati guṇavati ca prasādākārā ,
sati guṇavati ca prāptum utpādayituṃ śakye 'bhilāṣākārā /
nanvevam abhilāṣākāratvāt tṛṣṇācchandayor anyatarā bhavati /
naitad evam /
kuśalaviṣayatvān na tṛṣṇā ,
śraddhāpūrvakatvāc chandasya na cchandaḥ /
cetasaḥ prasāda iti /
śraddhā hi cittakāluṣyavairodhikīty atas tatsamprayoge kleśopakleśamalakāluṣyavigamāc cittaṃ śraddhām āgamya prasīdatīti cetasaḥ prasāda ucyate
udakaprasādakamaṇisthānīyaṃ dharmāntaraṃ caitasikaṃ śraddhā ,
na rūpaprasādātmiketi pradarśanārtham āha -- cetasaḥ prasāda iti /
cetasaḥ prasādo ,
na rūpasyeti /
sā punaś chandasanniśrayadānakarmikā //
hrīḥ katamā /
ātmānaṃ dharmaṃ vādhipatiṃ kṛtvāvadyena lajjā /
yatpratibaddhā yasya kriyāsu pravṛttir nivṛttir vā sa tasyādhipatiḥ svā[p. 44]mītyarthaḥ /
ātmānaṃ dharmaṃ vādhipatiṃ svāminaṃ kṛtvā /
sadbhir vigarhitatvād aniṣṭavipākatvāc ca pāpam evāvadyam /
tenāvadyena kṛtenākṛtena vā cittasyāvalīnatā lajjā /
kulajñānādibhir guṇaiḥ pāpakriyāyām ātmānam ayogyaṃ matvā ,
kathaṃ hi nāma mayaivaṃvidhenaivaṃ pāpaṃ kṛtaṃ kriyate kariṣyate vā ,
dharme 'py etad aniṣṭavipākatvāt paropaghātapravṛttatvāc ca garhitam -- ity evaṃ yātmānaṃ dharmaṃ cāvekṣamāṇasyāvadyena lajjā ,
sā hrīḥ /
iyaṃ ca duścaritasaṃyamanasanniśrayadānakarmikā //
apatrāpyaṃ katamat /
lokam adhipatiṃ kṛtvāvadyena lajjā /
loke hy etad garhitam ,
māṃ caivaṅkarmāṇaṃ viditvā vigarhiṣyantīty aślokādibhayād avadyena lajjate /
idam api duścaritasaṃyamanasanniśrayadānakarmakam eva /
duścaritād viratiḥ saṃyamanam /
lajjamānasyāpatrapamāṇasya vā kṛte 'pi duścarite 'vaśyaṃ tadviramaṇād anayos ta[p. 45]tsanniśrayadānakarmakatvam //
alobha iti /
ayam akāras triṣv artheṣu vartate /
abhāve /
'nyasmin pratipakṣe ca /
atra pratipakṣa eva vartate nānyasmin nābhāva iti pradarśanārtham āha -- lobhapratipakṣa iti /
evam adveṣe amohe ca vaktavyam /
nirvid anāgraha iti tatsvarūpanirūpaṇam /
lobho nāma bhave bhavopakaraṇeṣu ca āsaktiḥ prārthanā ca /
tatpratipakṣo 'lobho bhave bhavopakaraṇeṣu cānāsaktir vaimukhyaṃ ca /
nirvid bhavabhogādīnavānāṃ parijñānād bhave bhavopakaraṇeṣu ca vaimukhyam /
anāgraho bhavabhavabhogayor asaktiḥ /
athavānāgrahaviśeṣaṇārthaṃ nirvidgrahaṇaṃ -- bhave bhavopakaraṇeṣu ca vaimukhyākāro yo 'nāgraho 'yam alobha iti /
ayaṃ ca duścaritāpravṛttisanniśrayadānakarmaka iti //
adveṣaḥ katamaḥ /
dveṣapratipakṣo maitrī /
dveṣo hi sattveṣu duḥkhe duḥkhasthānīyeṣu ca dharmeṣv āghātaḥ /
tatpratipakṣo 'nāghātaḥ /
dveṣasyānye 'pi pratipakṣāḥ santīty ata āha -- maitrī /
maitrātmako dveṣasya yaḥ pratipakṣaḥ so 'dveṣaḥ ,
nānya iti /
ayam api duścaritāpravṛttisa[p. 46]nniśrayadānakarmaka iti //
amohaḥ katamaḥ /
mohapratipakṣo bhūtasampratipattiḥ /
sarva eva hi kuśalā dharmāḥ kliṣṭānāṃ dharmāṇāṃ samudācāravirodhāt pratipakṣa ity ata āha -- bhūtasampratipattir iti /
saṃyagaviparītapratipattibhedāt /
sā punar dvividhā -- jñānaṃ pratisaṅkhyā ca /
punaś caturvidhā vipākāgamacintādhigamanimittā /
pratisaṅkhyā tu prajñaiva dhairyasahitā /
dhairyam iti prajñāvīryasamādhaya ucyante /
tatra dvayoḥ prajñādravyayoḥ samavadhānāsambhavād vīryeṇa samādhinā vā samprayuktā prajñā pratisaṅkhyety ucyate ,
yadbalenānuddhṛtānupahatakleśabījo 'pi kleśānām avakāśan na dadati /
ayam atra vākyārthaḥ -- yathābhūtajñānātmakaḥ pratisaṅkhyātmakaś ca jñānaviśeṣo 'moha ity ucyate /
ata evāmoho duścaritāpravṛttisanniśrayadānakarmakaḥ //
vīryaṃ katamat /
kausīdyapratipakṣaḥ kuśale cetaso 'bhyutsāhaḥ /
kutsitaṃ sīdatīti kusīdaḥ /
tadbhāvaḥ kausīdyam /
ālasyam ity arthaḥ /
tac ca kuśalākuśalayoś cittasyānutsāhaḥ ,
tatpratipakṣaś ca vīryam ity ataḥ kausīdyavad ubhayaprasaṅge vyavacchedārtham [p. 47] āha -- kuśale cetaso 'bhyutsāho vīryam ,
na tu kliṣṭa iti /
kliṣṭe tūtsāhaḥ kutsitatvāt kausīdyam eva /
nanu ca kliṣṭaṃ svabhyastatvāt svarasenaiva pravartate /
kiṃ tatrotsāhena /
prāyeṇaivam ,
asti tu kiñcid yatrotsāho 'py apekṣyate /
tat punar yatsamprayogāt sannāhe prayoge vālīnatve vāvyāvṛttau vāsantuṣṭau vā kuśaleṣu dharmeṣu cetaso 'bhyutsāhaḥ ,
tad vīryam /
kuśalapakṣaparipūraṇapariniṣpādanakarmakam /
paripūraṇaṃ yathā maulapraveśaḥ /
pariniṣpādanaṃ tasyaiva parikarmakṛtatvam //
prasrabdhiḥ katamā /
dauṣṭhulyapratipakṣaḥ kāyacittakarmaṇyatā /
dauṣṭhulyaṃ kāyacittayor akarmaṇyatā sāṅkleṣikadharmabījāni ca /
tadapagame prasrabdhisadbhāvād dauṣṭhulyapratipakṣaḥ /
lakṣaṇaṃ tu prasrabdheḥ kāyacittakarmaṇyatā /
tatra kāyakarmaṇyatā kāyasya svakāryeṣu laghusamutthānatā yato bhavati /
cittakarmaṇyatā samyaṅmanasikāraprayuktasya hlādalāghavanimittaṃ yac caitasikaṃ dharmāntaram /
tadyogāc cittam asaktam ālambane pravartata ity atas tac cittakarmaṇyatety ucyate /
kāya[p. 48]sya punaḥ spraṣṭavyaviśeṣa eva prītyāhṛtaḥ kāyaprasrabdhir veditavyā /
prītamanasaḥ kāyaḥ prasrabhyata iti sūtre vacanāt /
atra caitasikādhikārād acaitasiky api kāyaprasrabdhiḥ prasrabdhisambodhyaṅgatvenoktā ,
kāyakarmaṇyatā vā cittakarmaṇyatām āvāhayatīty ato 'caitasiky api kāyakarmaṇyatātroktā /
iyaṃ ca tadbalenāśrayaparāvṛttito 'śeṣakleśādyāvaraṇaniṣkarṣaṇakarmikā //
apramādaḥ katamaḥ /
pramādapratipakṣo 'lobho yāvad vīryam ,
yān niśrityākuśalān dharmān prajahāti ,
tatpratipakṣāṃś ca kuśalān dharmān bhāvayatīti /
pramādo hi yena kleśebhyaś cittaṃ na rakṣati kuśalaṃ ca hāpayati /
apramādena punaḥ kleśān prajahāti pratipakṣāṃś ca dharmān bhāvayatīty ato 'pramādaḥ pramādapratipakṣa uktaḥ /
alobho yāvad vīryam ity alobhādveṣāmohāḥ saha vīryeṇa gṛhyante /
yān alobhādīn vīryaparyantān niśrityāgamya prāpyākuśalān dharmān prajahātīty anena sarve alobhādayo 'pramāda ity uktaṃ bhavati /
akuśalā dharmā āsravā āsravasthānīyāś ca viṣayā veditavyāḥ /
[p. 49] tatra āsravāṇām vinodanaviṣkambhaṇabījasamuddhārātmakaṃ prahāṇam /
viṣayāṇāṃ punaḥ parivarjanena prahāṇam /
tatpratipakṣā ity akuśaladharmapratipakṣāḥ /
te punaḥ kuśalasāsravā anāsravāś ca /
teṣām abhyāso bhāvanā ,
paunaḥpunyena sammukhīkaraṇam /
yasmād vīryasahītān alobhādīn niśrityākuśalān dharmān prajahāti tatpratipakṣāṃś ca dharmān bhāvayati ,
tasmāt savīryeṣv alobhādiṣv apramādaḥ prajñapyate -- ity anena sādhiṣṭhānā sakāraṇā cāpramādasya prajñaptir uktā /
sa punaḥ sarvalaukikalokottarasampattiparipūraṇakarmakaḥ /
tatra laukikasampattir bhavabhogaviśeṣalābhaḥ ,
lokottarā śrāvakādibodhyadhigamaḥ //
upekṣā katamā /
sa evālobho yāvad vīryam ityādi -- apramāda ivātrāpi vyākhyānam /
cittasamatādibhis tribhiḥ padair upekṣāyā ādimadhyāvasānāvasthā dyotitā /
tatra layauddhatyaṃ cetaso vaiṣamyam /
tasyābhāvād ādau cittasya samatā /
tato 'nabhisaṃskāreṇāprayatnena samāhitasya cetaso yathāyogaṃ samasyaiva pravṛttiḥ praśaṭhatā /
sā punar avasthā layauddhatyāśaṅkānugatā ,
acirabhāvitatvāt /
tato bhāvanāprakarṣagamanāt tadvipakṣadūrībhāvāt tacchaṅkābhāve layauddhatyapratipakṣani[p. 50]mitteṣv ābhogam akurvato 'nābhogāvasthatā cittasyānābhogatā
yayā nirvāsiteṣu kliṣṭeṣu dharmeṣv iti /
yayety upekṣaiva sambadhyate /
kliṣṭā dharmā rāgādisahitāḥ /
teṣāṃ nirvāsanaṃ punar anutpattiḥ /
upekṣā hi saṅkliṣṭavihāravairodhikīty avaśyaṃ tayā rāgādipravṛttivibandhe vartitavyam ity atas tayā nirvāsiteṣv ity uktam /
yataś ca saṅkliṣṭena vihāreṇopekṣā virūdhyate ,
tenopekṣāvihāry asaṅkliṣṭavihārī bhavatīti /
ataś copekṣā saṅkleśānavakāśasanniśrayadānakarmikā //
avihiṃsā katamā /
vihiṃsāpratipakṣaḥ karuṇeti /
vadhabandhādibhir aviheṭhanam adrohaṇaṃsattvānām avihiṃseti vihiṃsāpratipakṣaḥ /
kaṃ ruṇaddhīti karuṇā /
kam iti sukhasyākhyā /
sukhaṃ ruṇaddhīty arthaḥ /
kāruṇiko hi paraduḥkhaduḥkhī bhavatīti /
iyaṃ cāpramādavat prajñaptita eva ,
na dravyasatī ,
adveṣāṃśa eva prajñapanāt /
aviheṭhanakarmikā /
uktā ekādaśa kuśalāḥ //
ṣaṭ kleśā vaktavyāḥ /
ta ucyante -- rāgaḥ katamaḥ /
pañcasūpādānaskandheṣu sneho 'dhyavasānaṃ /
sāsravāṇi rūpavedanāsañjñāsaṃskāravijñānāni pañca rūpavedanāsañjñāsaṃskāravijñānopadānaskandhāḥ /
[p. 51] tatra rūpopādānaskandho dvaidhātukaṃ rūpam /
vedanādyupādānaskandhāś catvāras traidhātukā vedanādayaḥ /
upādīyate 'nayā tṛṣṇayā tribhavotpattiḥ paunarbhavikaṃ vā karmeti tṛṣṇāyā upādānākhyā /
upādānasambhūtatvād upādānavidheyatvād upādānāni vā tebhyaḥ sambhavantīty upādānaskandhāḥ /
sneha iva snehaḥ /
yathā hi tailādikaḥ sneho vastrādikam āśrayam anupraviśya vyāpnoti ,
mahatāpi ca yatnena svāśrayād durvivecyaḥ ,
evaṃ rāgo 'pi svālambanam anupraviśyaiva vyāpnoti mahatāpi ca prayāsena tasmādālambanāt durvivecya iti sneha ucyate /
adhyavasānaṃ tanmayatā /
athavā spraṣṭavyaviśeṣo 'pi sneha iti vyavacchedārtham āha -- adhyavasānam iti /
sa punar duḥkhasañjananakarmakaḥ /
triduḥkhatāyogād yathāsambhavaṃ traidhātukāḥ pañca skandhā duḥkham abhipretam tasya ca duḥkhasya kāmarūpārūpyatṛṣṇāvaśenābhinirvṛttito rāgasya
duḥkhasañjananaṃ karma nirdiśyate //
pratighaḥ katamaḥ /
sattveṣv āghāta iti /
āghātaḥ sattveṣu rūkṣacittatā yenāviṣṭaḥ sattvānāṃ vadhabandhādikam anarthaṃ cintayati /
sa punar asparśavihāraduścaritasanniśrayadānakarmakaḥ /
sparśaḥ sukham /
tena sahito vihāraḥ sparśavihāraḥ /
na sparśavihāro 'sparśavihāraḥ ,
duḥkhasahita ity arthaḥ /
āghātacittasyāvaśyaṃ daurmanasyasamudācārāc [p. 52] cittaṃ tapyate /
cittānuvidhānāc ca kāyo 'pi tapyata eveti /
sarveryāpatheṣu saduḥkhasavighāto 'sya vihāro bhavati /
pratihatacittasya ca na kiñcid duścaritaṃ vidūr -- iti pratigho 'sparśavihāraduścaritasanniśrayadānakarmaka uktaḥ //
mānaḥ katamaḥ /
sapta mānā iti /
māno hi sarva eva satkāyadṛṣṭisanniśrayeṇa pravartate ,
cittasya connatilakṣaṇaḥ /
tathā hy ātmātmīyabhāvaṃ skandheṣv adhyāropyāyam aham idaṃ mamety ātmānaṃ tena tena viśeṣeṇonnamayati anyebhyo 'dhikaṃ manyate /
sa cāgauravaduḥkhotpattisanniśrayadānakarmakaḥ /
agauravaṃ guruṣu guṇavatsu ca pudgaleṣu stabdhatā kāyavācor apasṛtatā /
duḥkhotpattiḥ punar atra punarbhavotpattir veditavyā /
sa punaś cittonnatisvabhāvābhede 'pi cittonnatinimittabhedāt saptadhā bhidyate -- māno 'timāna ity evamādi //
hīnāt kulavijñānavittādibhiḥ śreyān asmi kulavijñānavittādibhir iti yā cittasyonnatiḥ ,
sadṛśena vā kulādibhis tair eva sadṛśo 'smīti yā cittasyonnatiḥ ,
sa mānaḥ /
atimānaḥ kulavijñānavittādibhiḥ sadṛśāt tyāgaśīlapauruṣādibhiḥ śreyān a[p. 53]smi ,
śreyasā vā kulavittādibhiḥ sadṛśo 'smi vijñānavittādibhir iti yā cittasyonnatiḥ ,
ayam atimāna iti /
mānātimānaḥ śreyasaḥ kulavijñānavittair aham eva śreyān kulavijñānavittair iti yā cittasyonnatiḥ ,
ayaṃ mānātimānaḥ /
asmimānaḥ pañcopādānaskandhān iti /
chandarāgau hy atropādānam /
anāgatātmabhāvābhilāṣaś chandaḥ /
vartamānādhyavasānaṃ rāgaḥ /
tatrānāgatātmabhāvaṃ chandamukhenopādatte /
vartamānaskandhān rāgamukhenāparityāgata upādatte /
ata etad eva dvayamupādānam ity ucyate /
tena yuktāḥ skandhā upādānaskandhāḥ /
teṣūpādānaskandheṣv ātmātmīyarahiteṣv ātmātmīyābhiniveśād yā cittasyonnatir ,
ayam asmimānaḥ /
abhimāno 'prāpta uttariviśeṣādhigame prāpto mayeti yā cittasyonnatiḥ /
manuṣyadharmā rāgadveṣamohādayaḥ ,
tatpravartitaṃ ca kāyavāṅmanaskarma /
tatpratipakṣabhūtaṃ yad dhyānasamāpattyādikam ,
tan manuṣyadharmebhya uttariviśeṣa ucyate /
tasmin viśeṣādhigama 'prāpte sati prāpto mayā uttariviśeṣādhigama iti yā cittasyonnatiḥ ,
so 'bhimā[p. 54]naḥ /
ūnamāno bahvantaraviśiṣṭāt kulavidyāvittādibhir alpāntarahīno 'smi kulādibhir iti yā cittasyonnatiḥ /
yuktaṃ tāvat samena samaḥ ,
samānād vā viśiṣṭaḥ ,
viśiṣṭād vā viśiṣṭa ity unnatisthānatvān mānaḥ ,
ātmānaṃ tu nyūnaṃ paśyataḥ kim unnatisthānaṃ ,
yatas tasya māna ucyate /
etad evonnatisthānaṃ bahvantaraviśiṣṭād alpāntarahīno 'smi na yathābahvantarahīnād iti /
api ca santi kecid ye prakṛṣṭe ca sattvarāśau hīnam apy ātmānaṃ bahu manyante /
mithyāmāno 'guṇavato guṇavān asmīti yā cittasyonnatiḥ /
guṇā dānaśīlakṣāntyādayaḥ /
te yasya na vidyante so 'guṇavān /
athavā 'guṇā dauḥśīlyādayaḥ /
te yasya santi so 'guṇavān /
tasmād aguṇavato guṇavān asmīti /
aguṇavata iti -- anena hi dānaśīlādyabhāve guṇavattvam abhyupagataṃ bhavatīty ato nirvastukatvān mithyāmāna ucyate //
avidyā katamā /
karmaphalasatyaratneṣv ajñānam /
sā punaḥ [p. 55] sahajā parikalpitā ca /
tatra sahajānyakleśāsamprayogād āveṇikī /
parikalpitā vicikitsāmithyādṛṣṭiśīlavrataparāmarṣādikleśasamprayuktā /
karmaṇy ajñānaṃ puṇyāpuṇyāniñjyakarmāstitve yad ajñānam apratipattir anavabodhaḥ ,
iyaṃ sahajā avidyā /
puṇyāpuṇyāniñjyakarmāstitve vicikitsato vāpavadato vā nāsti puṇyam apuṇyam āniñjyaṃ ceti ,
paśubandhāgnipraveśādinivartane puṇye 'puṇyasañjñinām /
paśubandhāgnipraveśādike vāpuṇye puṇyasañjñināṃ yā vicikitsāmithyādṛṣṭisamprayuktā avidyā ,
sā parikalpitā /
sā dharmeṣu mithyāniścayavicikitsāsaṅkleśotpattisanniśrayadānakarmikā //
prajñā nitīraṇātmikā dṛṣṭir ucyata ity ato laukikīsaṃyagdṛṣṭyādiprasaṅge dṛṣṭir iti satkāyadṛṣṭyādikāḥ pañca dṛṣṭaya ihābhipretā iti pradarśann
āha -- pañca dṛṣṭaya iti /
tāsāṃ kliṣṭatvāviśeṣe 'py ā[p. 56]lambanākārabhedād bhedapradarśanārthaṃ punar apy āha -- satkāyadṛṣṭir antagrāhadṛṣṭir iti vistaraḥ //
nsīdatīti sat /
cayaḥ kāyaḥ /
vinaśvare saṅghāte iyaṃ dṛṣṭir nātmani nātmīye ceti jñāpitaṃ bhavati /
ātmā hi nityaś caikaś cātmavādibhir abhyupagamyate ,
iyaṃ cānityānekaviṣayatvān nātmaviṣayety uktaṃ bhavati /
pañcopādānaskandhān ityādi -- ye kecic chramaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā ātmānam ātmīyaṃ veti samanupaśyantaḥ samanupaśyanti ,
ta imān eva pañcopādānaskandhān iti sūtra uktam /
te hi svarūpataḥ kāryato vā ātmānaṃ prajñapayeyuḥ /
sāṅkhyāś caitanyasvarūpam ātmānaṃ manyante /
te ca cittacaitasikaprabhede 'vidvāṃsaḥ sakalaṃ cittacaitasikakalāpam eva caitanyam ity āhuḥ /
atas te caturaḥ skandhān ātmeti pratipannāḥ ,
rūpaskandham ātmīyatvena /
na ca buddhivṛttito 'nyac caitanyaṃ svasthacittena śakyate vaktuṃ pratipattum vā /
evam vedanādīnām ekeṣāṃ ca nirgranthānāṃ jñānasvarūpa ātmeti teṣām ātmātmīyagrāho 'nantarokta eva draṣṭavyaḥ /
vaiśeṣikādayas tu kāryata ātmānaṃ vyapadiśanti -- yaḥ paśyati yāvan manyate ,
tathā yo vedayate [p. 57] jānāti smarati cetayate vijānāti ca ,
sa ātmeti /
teṣām api cakṣurādiṣv evātmābhimānaḥ /
yasmāc cakṣurvyatirikto yaḥ paśyati tasyābhāvaḥ /
cakṣurvijñāne hi darśanasamākhyā /
tasyāsādharaṇakāraṇatvāc cakṣuḥ paśyatīti vyapadiśyate /
tadyathā nādasyāsādhāraṇakāraṇatvād ghaṇṭā rautīty ucyate /
yatra tarhi cakṣuṣā rūpāṇi dṛṣṭvā naiva sumanā bhavati naiva durmanā iti ,
tatra katham /
tatrāpi yatrātmaprajñaptiḥ samūhe santāne vā ,
sa eva cakṣuṣā rūpāṇi dṛṣṭvety ucyate /
rūpanirbhāsataiva hi rūpadarśanam ,
yasmāt tadbhāvābhāve rūpasya darśanādarśane vyavasthāpyete /
evaṃ śravaṇādiṣv api vaktavyam /
yatra tūktaṃ vedayata iti vedanā ,
evaṃ yāvad vijānātīti vijñānam /
tatra bhāvamātre kartṛvyapadeśaḥ ,
vijñānavyatiriktavijñātṛpratiṣedhārtham /
evaṃ vedanādiṣv api vaktavyam /
athavā viṣayanirbhāsatām upādāya kartṛvyapadeśaḥ ,
yathoktaṃ prāk /
na cātmalābhavyatiriktā kriyā vidyate ,
kṣaṇikatvāt sarvabhāvānāṃ kriyākāle 'navasthānāt /
na cākartṛkā kriyāsti /
ātmalābhānantaraṃ ca bhāvānāṃ nirhetukatvād yadi vināśo na syāt ,
paścād api na syāt ,
vinaṣṭur vināśasya ca paścād ātmātiśayābhāvāt /
sahetukavināśaparikalpe ca vinaṣṭaiva tadvyatirikto vā vinā[p. 58]śahetuḥ parikalpyeta /
pūrvasmin pakṣa ātmalābhānantaraṃ bhāvānāṃ vināśaḥ ,
naiva vāsti vināśa iti prasajyate /
yo 'nyanirapekṣaḥ pūrvaṃ yasya na kāraṇam ,
sa paścād api tasya naiva kāraṇam ,
ātmātiśayābhāvāt /
itarasminn api pakṣe vināśānāṃ kāraṇaniyamo na syāt /
kāryāṇām iva tadvināśānām api kāraṇaniyamo bhaviṣyati /
naitad evam ,
kāryāṇāṃ hi parasparato bhinnasvarūpatvāt tatkāraṇānām api śaktibhedāt niyamo na virudhyate /
vināśānāṃ tu nirupākhyatvād ātmātiśayābhāve kiṅkṛto 'yaṃ niyamaḥ /
tasmāt sarvaṃ vā vināśakāraṇaṃ sarvavināśasya ,
naiva vā vināśakāraṇam astīti pratipattavyam /
vināśaś ca yadi vināśakāraṇāt pūrvam apy asti ,
evaṃ sati vināśakāraṇavaiyarthyaṃ prasajyeta /
bhāvānāṃ ca vināśe saty utpattir iti vinaṣṭānām apy utpattiprasaṅgaḥ /
atha vināśakāraṇebhyaḥ pūrvaṃ na vidyate ,
evaṃ sati bhāvavad abhāvasyāpi prāgabhāvaḥ prajyate /
yasya ca prāgabhāvaḥ ,
tasya cāvaśyaṃ bhāvatvāt pradhvaṃsābhāvenāpi bhavitavyam /
evaṃ bhāvābhāvayor aviśeṣāt sarvaṃ bhāvātmakam abhāvātmakam vā prasajyeta /
yadi ca pradhvaṃsābhāvasyāpi pradhvaṃsābhāvaḥ ,
evaṃ pradhvaṃsābhāvānām anavasthānāt tatkāraṇānām api /
neṣyate ,
evaṃ sati bhā[p. 59]vapradhvaṃsābhāvasyāpi naiveṣṭavyā dvayor apy ātmātiśayatvābhāvāt /
kriyā ca bhāvebhyo 'nyā 'nanyā vā parikalpyeta /
yady ananyā ,
ātmaivātmanaḥ kartā karma ceti na yujyate /
yadi ca labdhātmakaḥ kriyāṃ karoti ,
nāsau tasyātmabhūtā /
yo hi yena vināpi bhavati ,
na sa tasyātmabhūto yujyate /
kriyāśūnye ca kartṛtvaṃ na yujyate /
kriyārahitāc ca kriyādhyāsito 'nya eveti kathaṃ kartuḥ karmaṇo vātmabhūtā /
kriyārahitatadadhyāsitayoś ca yaugapadyādarśanāt pūrvavināśa uttarasyotpādo 'bhyupagantavyaḥ /
athālabdhātmakaḥ ,
evam api tasya kartṛtvaṃ kriyāyāś ca tadātmabhūtatvaṃ na yujyate ,
dvayor apy asattvāt /
kiṃ caikasya kriyārahitatvāt ,
dvitīyasya kriyādhyāsitatvāt kartṛtvābhāvaḥ ,
kartur abhāvāc ca kriyāyā apy abhāva iti ,
evaṃ ca svarasavināśāt kṣaṇikatvam evābhyupagataṃ bhavati /
kartṛkarmaṇor anyāpi kriyā naivāsti /
kārakair hi kriyā janyate /
janyatvāc ca karmaiva bhavati /
na ca niḥkriyaṃ karma kartā vā yujyata ity avaśyaṃ tatrānyayā kriyayā bhavitavyam ,
tatrāpy anyayety anavasthā kriyāṇāṃ kartṝṇāṃ ca /
atha kriyākriyāntarām anapekṣā janyate ,
evaṃ tarhi dravyam eva [p. 60] kriyāntararahitaṃ janyatvena kiṃ neṣyate /
kim arthāntarabhūtayādṛṣṭasvarūpasāmarthyayā kriyayā parikalpitayā /
yadi ca kriyā kārakair janyate ,
na dravyam ,
evaṃ prākpradhvaṃsābhāvau kriyāyā eva ,
na dravyasyeti sarvadravyāṇi nityāni ,
naiva vā santīty abhyupeyam /
yadi ca kārakebhyo 'nyā kriyā ,
kriyārahitaṃ ca sādhanam ,
evaṃ kriyāṇām anavasthānaṃ sādhanābhāvo vā /
sādhanābhāvāc ca kriyābhāvo 'pi /
na hy asādhanā kriyāsti /
yadi ca gantur anyā gatiḥ ,
taṇḍulebhyo 'nyā paciḥ ,
evaṃ sati gantur na deśāntaraprāptiḥ ,
taṇḍulānām vāpacanaṃ ,
pūrvāvasthāto 'vikṛtatvāt /
atha kriyaiva svāśrayasya vikārahetur iti pūrvāvasthāto vikṛtatvam apratiṣiddham /
vikāro hi pūrvasmād ātmātiśayaḥ /
sa cānyatvāvinābhāvī/
tasmād avaśyaṃ pūrvottarayor yaugapadyābhāvāt pūrvavināśenābhinnakālam uttarasyotpādo 'bhyupagantavyaḥ /
evaṃ kriyāyā āśrayābhāvād anavasthitatvāt kuto vikārahetutvam /
tasmād ātmalābhānantaravināśeṣu nirīheṣv antarvyāpārapuruṣarahiteṣu pañcasūpādānaskandheṣv eva sadbhāvamātreṇa prāgabhūtānām anyeṣāṃ skandhānāṃ
hetubhāvena vyavasthiteṣu nityakartṛbhoktṛgrāhapūrvako 'yam ātmātmīyagrāhaḥ ,
nātmany ātmīye ceti /
[p. 61] ātmata ātmīyato cety antagrāhadṛṣṭito vyavacchinatti /
samanupaśyata iti niścinvataḥ /
yā kliṣṭā prajñeti /
na hy amūḍhasyānātmany ātmeti jñānaṃ bhavati /
ato mohasamprayogād viparyastatvāc ca kliṣṭā /
tatra svasantatipatitān ātmatvena samanupaśyati ,
parasantatipatitān anupāttāṃś cātmīyatvena /
yadāpi svasantatipatitānām ekadeśam ātmatvena ,
tadā itarān apy ātmīyatvena /
iyaṃ ca sarvadṛṣṭigatasanniśrayadānakarmikā //
tām evādhipatiṃ kṛtveti satkāyadṛṣṭim /
satkāyadṛṣṭibalena tadutpatteḥ ,
satkāyadṛṣṭis tasyā adhipatiḥ /
śāśvatata ucchedato veti -- yat satkāyadṛṣṭyātmatvena vastv ālambitam ,
tad eva śāśvatata iti nityataḥ ,
ucchedata ity ucchedo 'trāpratisandhiko vināśaḥ /
samanupaśyato yā kliṣṭā prajñeti pūrvavad vācyam /
iyaṃ ca madhyamāpratipanniryāṇaparipanthakarmikā /
madhyamā pratipac chāśvatocchedagrāhavarjitaṃ pratītyasamutpādajñānam //
[p. 62] hetum vāpavadataḥ phalaṃ vā kriyāṃ vā sad vā vastu nāśayata ityādi -- sucaritādikam ,
sugatidurgatī ,
mātādikriyām ,
arhadādikaṃ ca yathākramaṃ hetvādikam /
kuśalamūlasamucchedakarmikākuśalamūladṛḍhatāsanniśrayadānakarmikā ceyam /
sā tu viśiṣṭaiva na sarvā /
dṛṣṭiparāmarśaḥ katama iti /
dṛṣṭyādīn paratvenāmṛśatīti dṛṣṭiparāmarśaḥ /
tām eva ca trividhāṃ dṛṣṭim iti satkāyadṛṣṭim antagrāhadṛṣṭiṃ mithyādṛṣṭiṃ ca /
tadāśrayāṃś ca skandhān iti /
ye draṣṭur ātmabhāvasaṃśabditāḥ ,
yān āśritya dṛṣṭayaḥ pravartante ,
te tadāśrayā /
agrataḥ śreṣṭhato viśiṣṭataḥ paramata iti /
ete 'grādayaḥ śabdās tulyārthā apy uttarottaravyākhyānatvenopāttāḥ /
ayaṃ cāsaddṛṣyabhiniveśasanniśrayadānakarmakaḥ /
dṛṣṭilakṣaṇasyābhiniveśasya guṇarūpeṇa grahaṇāt tadaparityāgamukhena sarvadṛṣṭīnām ayaṃ sanniśraya ity uktaṃ bhava[p. 63]ti //
śīlaṃ vrataṃ tadāśrayāṃśca skandhān iti /
dauḥśīlyaviratiḥ śīlam ,
veśavṛttakāyavākpravṛttirniyamo vratam /
yān āśritya skandhāñ chīlaṃ vrataṃ vā pravartate ,
te śīlavratāśrayāḥ skandhāḥ /
kutsitāṃ dṛṣṭiṃ guṇato gṛhītvā tatpūrvakaṃ śīlaṃ vrataṃ vā paratvenāmṛśatīti śīlavrataparāmarśaḥ /
ata eva śīlavrataparāmarśād dṛṣṭiparāmarśaḥ pūrva uktaḥ /
śudhyate 'nena vā pāpācayanāt (?) śīlena vratena ceti śuddhiḥ /
mucyate 'nena kleśabandhād iti muktiḥ /
niryāty anena saṃsārād iti niryāṇam /
niryāṇam eva nairyāṇiko mokṣamārga ity arthaḥ /
samanupaśyata iti nirūpayataḥ /
śīle vrate vā śuddhyādyākārair abhiniveśātmikā prajñā śīlavrataparāmarśaḥ /
kliṣṭā tu viparītālambanatvāt /
ayaṃ ca śramavaiphalyasanniśrayadānakarmakaḥ //
vicikitsā katamā /
satyādiṣu yā vimatir iti /
ādiśabdena karmaphalaratnāni gṛhyante /
dvidhā matir vimatiḥ -- syān na syād [p. 64] iti /
prajñātaś ceyaṃ jātyantaram eva draṣṭavyā /
sā kuśalapakṣāpravṛttisanniśrayadānakarmikā //
kleśānāṃ ca rāgādīnāṃ kati parikalpitā eva ,
kati sahajāḥ parikalpitāś cety āha -- tisro dṛṣṭayaḥ parikalpitāḥ eveti /
tās tu pūrvā api santīty ata āha paścimā iti /
tāḥ punar mithyādṛṣṭir dṛṣṭiparāmarśaḥ śīlavrataparāmarśaś ca /
na kevalam etā eva parikalpitāḥ ,
kiṃ tarhi vicikitsā ca parikalpitā /
śeṣāḥ sahajāḥ parikalpitāś cety ubhayathā /
ke punaḥ śeṣāḥ /
rāgapratighamānāvidyāḥ satkāyadṛṣṭir antagrāhadṛṣṭiś ca //
uktāḥ kleśāḥ upakleśā vaktavyāḥ /
ta ucyante /
vartamānaṃ pratyutpannam ,
nānāgatam atītam vā /
apakāram āgamyety apakāraṃ gṛhītvety anena krodhasya viṣayaṃ nirūpayati /
krodho hy apakāravastuny eva vartamāna eva pravartate ,
nānyatreti /
cetasa āghāta ity atrāpi vijñānasambandhitvaṃ svarūpaṃ ca nirūpitam /
ayaṃ cāghātasvarūpatvāt pratighān na bhidyate ,
kiṃ tarhi pratighāṃśika eva ,
pratighasyāṃ[p. 65]śe viśeṣe prajñaptatvāt /
vartamānam apakāram adhikṛtya yaś cetasa āghātaḥ sattvāsattvaviṣayo daṇḍādānādisanniśrayadānakarmakaś ca sa krodha iti prajñapyate //
krodhād ūrdhvaṃ mamānenedam apakṛtam ity etasya vairātmakasyāśayasyānubandho 'nutsargaḥ ,
prabandhena pravartanam upanāhaḥ /
akṣānti sanniśrayadānakarmakaḥ /
akṣāntir apakārāmarṣaṇaṃ ,
pratyapakāracikīrṣety arthaḥ /
ayaṃ ca krodhavat pradveṣāvasthāviśeṣe prajñapyata iti prajñaptisan veditavyaḥ //
chandadveṣabhayādīṃs tiraskṛtya kāle taddhitaiṣiṇā codakena tvam evaṅkārīty anuyuktasya mohāṃśiky avadyapracchādanā mrakṣaḥ /
mohāṃśikatvaṃ tu mrakṣasyāvacchādanākāratvāt /
kaukṛtyāsparśavihārasanniśrayadānakarmakaḥ /
dharmataiṣā yad avadyaṃ pracchādayataḥ kaukṛtyam /
kaukṛtyāc cāvaśyaṃ daurmanasyena samprayogād asparśavihāra iti //
caṇḍaṃ vacaḥ pragāḍhaṃ pāruṣyaṃ marmaghaṭṭanayogena /
daśanaśīlo dāśī /
tadbhāvo dāśitā /
ayaṃ ca bhāvapratyayaḥ svārthikaḥ /
caṇḍena vacasā [p. 66] pradaśatīti caṇḍavacodāśitā pradāśaḥ /
ayaṃ ca krodhopanāhapūrvaṅgamaś cetasa āghātasvabhāva iti pratighāṃśika eveti na dravyato vidyate /
ayaṃ ca vāgduścaritaprasavanakarmako 'sparśavihārakarmakaś ca /
tadvataḥ pudgalasya duḥsaṃvāsatvāt //
ābhasatkārakulaśīlaśrutādīn guṇān upalabhya dveṣāṃśikaś cetaso vyāroṣa īrṣyā /
svam āśayaṃ vyāpya roṣo vyāroṣaḥ /
daurmanasyasamprayogāt tatpūrvakaś cāsparśavihāra iti daurmanasyāsparśavihārakarmikā //
upāttaṃ vastu dharmāmiṣakauśalātmakaṃ yena pūjānugrahakāmyayārthine 'narthine vā dīyate ,
tad dānam /
tasmin sati dānābhāvāt tadvirodhīty ucyate /
lābhasatkārādhyavasitasya jīvitopakaraṇeṣu rāgāṃśikaś cetasa āgraho 'parityāgecchā mātsaryam /
idaṃ cāsaṃlekhasanniśrayadānakarmakam /
asaṃlekhaḥ punar mātsaryeṇānupayujyamānānām apy upakaraṇānāṃ sannicayād veditavyaḥ //
[p. 67] māyā paravañcanāyā abhūtārthasandarśanā /
lābhasatkārādhyavasitasya paravañcanābhiprāyeṇānyathā vyavasthitasya śīlāder arthasyānyathā prakāśanā /
iyaṃ ca yābhyāṃ rāgamohābhyām abhūtān guṇān prakāśayate tayoḥ samuditayoḥ prajñapyate -- iti krodhādivat prajñaptita eva ,
na dravyataḥ /
mithyājīvasanniśrayadānakarmikā /
kāyavākkuhanopāttāḥ śayyāsanādaya upajīvyante ,
na ca vyāyāmalabdhā iti mithyājīva ucyate //
śāṭhyaṃ katamat /
svadoṣapracchādanopāyasaṅgṛhītaṃ cetasaḥ kauṭilyaṃ /
svadoṣapracchādanopāyaḥ paravyāmohanam /
tat punar anyenānyat pratisarati kṣipaty aparisphuṭaṃ vā pratipadyate /
ata eva śāṭhyaṃ mrakṣād bhidyate /
sa hi parisphuṭam eva pracchādayati /
svadoṣapracchādanopāyasaṅgrahas tannimittatvāt /
cetasaḥ kauṭilyaṃ vaṅkatā ,
yasya yogāc cittam ṛjumārgaṃ na pratipadyate /
idaṃ ca lābhasatkārādhyavasito yābhyāṃ rāgamohābhyāṃ svadoṣapracchādanārthaṃ paramohanāya pravartate ,
tayor eva sahitayos tat prajñapyate /
idaṃ ca saṃyagavavādalābhaparipanthakarmakam /
saṃyagavavāde yo lābho yoniśo manaskāraḥ ,
tasyānta[p. 68]rāyaṃ karotīti //
madaḥ svasampattau raktasyoddharṣaś cetasaḥ paryādānam /
kulārogyarūpayauvanabalaiśvaryabuddhimedhādiprakarṣaḥ svasampattiḥ /
uddharṣo harṣaviśeṣaḥ /
harṣaviśeṣam eva vyācaṣṭe -- cetasaḥ paryādānam iti /
yena harṣaviśeṣeṇa cittam asvatantrīkṛtaṃ tena tad ātmatantrīkaraṇāt paryāttaṃ bhavatītyata uktam -- cetasaḥ paryādānam iti /
eṣa saṅkṣepo harṣaviśeṣasahitas tṛṣṇāprakāro mada iti /
ayaṃ ca sarvakleśopakleśasanniśrayadānakarmakaḥ //
vividhair vadhabandhanatāḍanatarjanādibhiḥ sattvānāṃ hiṃsā vihiṃsā /
viheṭhyante 'nayā sattvā vadhabandhanādibhir duḥkhadaurmanasyotpādanād iti viheṭhanā /
sā punaḥ pratighāṃśikā nirghṛṇatā niṣkaruṇatā nirdayatā ca /
etāś ca nirghṛṇatādayaḥ svayaṃ vadhādiṃ kurvataḥ kārayataḥ paraiś ca kriyamāṇān dṛṣṭvā śrutvā vānumodataś ca yathākramaṃ boddhavyāḥ ,
uttarottaravyākhyānato vā /
eṣa tu saṅkṣepaḥ -- pratighāṃśikā sattveṣu cittarūkṣatā sattvaviheṭhanakarmikāvihiṃsety ucyate //
[p. 69] nāsya hrīr astīty ahrīḥ /
sa yadyogād evam ucyate ,
hrīvipakṣabhūtaṃ tad āhrīkyam /
tasmin karmaṇy ātmanam ayogyam avekṣyamāṇasyāpi yāvadyenālajjā ,
sāhrīkyam /
apatrapate 'nayety apatrāpyam /
tadviparītam anapatrāpyam /
lokaśāstraviruddham etan mayā kriyata /
ity evam avagacchato 'pi yānayā pāpakriyayālajjā ,
sānapatrāpyam /
etac ca dvayam api sarvakleśopakleśasāhāyyakarmakam /
rāgadveṣamohaprakāreṣu sarvasatkāyaprasavahetuṣu rāgadveṣayor ayaugapadyād yathāsambhavaṃ prajñapyate ,
na svatantre sta iti //
styānaṃ cittākarmaṇyatā /
paryāyāntareṇa vyācaṣṭe -- rstaimityam iti /
stimitabhāvaḥ staimityam ,
yadyogāc cittaṃ jaḍībhāvāt stimitam iva bhavati ,
nālambanaṃ pratipattum utsahate /
etac ca sarvakleśopakleśasāhāyyakarmakam /
mohāṃśe prajñaptatvāc ca prajñaptita eva ,
na dravyataḥ //
auddhatyaṃ cittasyāvyupaśamaḥ /
vyupaśamo hi śamathaḥ /
tadviru[p. 70]ddho 'vyupaśamaḥ /
sa punā rāgānukūlaḥ pūrvahasitaramitakrīḍitādy anusmarato rāgāṃśikaś cetaso 'vyupaśamahetuḥ /
śamathaparipanthakarmakam //
śraddhāvipakṣa iti /
śraddhāstitvaguṇavattvaśakyatveṣv abhisampratyayaḥ prasādo 'bhilāṣaś ca yathākramam /
aśraddhātadviparyayeṇāstitvaguṇavattvaśakyatveṣvasampratyayo 'prasādo 'nabhilāṣaś ca /
kauśīdyasanniśrayadānakarmakam /
aśraddhadhānasya prayogacchandābhāvāt kausīdyasanniśrayadānakarmakatvam //
kuśale kāyavāṅmanaḥkarmaṇi nidrāpārśvaśayanasukham āgamya yo mohāṃśikaś cetaso 'nabhyutsāhaḥ ,
sa kausīdyam /
kutsitaṃ sīdatīti kusīdaḥ /
tadbhāvaḥ kausīdyam ,
vīryavipakṣaḥ /
vīryavipakṣa iti /
vīryaṃ hi kuśalapakṣaprayoge cetaso 'bhyutsāhaḥ ,
tadvipakṣatvāt kausīdyam /
etac ca kuśalapakṣaprayogaparipanthakarmakam //
[p. 71] lobhadveṣamohakausīdyeṣu pramādaḥ prajñapyate ,
yathāvyākhyāteṣu /
ayaṃ cākuśalavṛddhikuśalaparihāṇisaṃniśrayadānakarmakaḥ //
muṣitasmṛtitā kliṣṭā smṛtiḥ /
kliṣṭeti kleśasamprayuktā /
kuśalasyānabhilapanateti -- na hi kleśasamprayuktā smṛtiḥ kleśenābhinnaviṣayatvāt kuśalam abhilapituṃ samarthā /
iyaṃ ca vikṣepasanniśrayadānakarmikā //
vividhaṃ kṣipyate 'nena cittam iti vikṣepaḥ /
yai rāgadveṣamohaiś cittaṃ samādhyālambanād bahir visāryate ,
teṣu yathāsambhavam upakleśātmako vikṣepaḥ prajñapyate /
eṣa ca vairāgyaparipanthakarmakaḥ //
asamprajanyaṃ kleśasamprayuktā prajñā /
yayāsamviditā kāyavākcittacaryābhikramapratikramādiṣu pravartate /
karaṇīyākaraṇīyājñānāc cāpattisanniśrayadānakarmakam /
kaukṛtyaṃ cetaso vipratisāraḥ /
kutsitaṃ kṛtam iti kukṛtam /
tadbhāvaḥ kaukṛtyam /
kukṛtaviṣayaś cetaso vilekhaḥ kaukṛtyam [p. 72] ucyate ,
caitasikādhikārāt /
abhipretam anabhipretaṃ kuśalam akuśalam avyākṛtaṃ kāle 'kāle yuktam ayuktaṃ ca kṛtvākṛtvā vā mohāṃśikaś cetaso vipratisāraḥ kaukṛtyam /
tac ca cittasthitiparipanthakarmakam /
anabhiratipūrvakaṃ yat kriyate ,
tad abhipretam /
anabhipretaṃ punaḥ parair balād avaṣṭabhya yat kāryate ,
kleśābhibhavād vā yat karoti /
kālo yāvan na viramati ,
akālas tadūrdhvam /
yuktaṃ sthāne ,
ayuktam asthāne /
tac cāpi trividham ,
kuśalam akuśalam avyākṛtaṃ ca /
mohāṃśikam ity upakleśasaṅgṛhītam atra gṛhyate //
middham asvatantravṛttiś cetaso 'bhisaṅkṣepaḥ /
vṛttir ālambane pravṛttiḥ /
sāsvatantrā cetaso yato bhavati ,
tan middham /
kāyasandhāraṇāsamarthā vā vṛttiś cetaso 'svatantrā ,
sā yato bhavati ,
tan middham /
anyato 'py asvatantrā vṛttiś cetaso bhavatīty ata āha -- cetaso 'bhisaṅkṣepa iti /
anyato 'py abhisaṅkṣepaś cetasa ity asvatantravṛttiś cetasa ity āha /
abhisaṅkṣepaś cetasaś cakṣurādīndriyadvāreṇāpravṛttiḥ /
sa punaḥ kuśalo 'kuśalo 'vyākṛtaś ca /
mi[p. 73]ddhanimittaṃ daurbalyaśramakāyagauravāndhakāranimittamanasikaraṇādikam āgamya mohāṃśiko bhavati /
kṛtyātipattisanniśrayadānakarmakam /
atra cākuśala eva mohāṃśikaḥ ,
nānyaḥ //
vitarkaḥ paryeṣako manojalpaś cetanāprajñāviśeṣaḥ /
paryeṣakaḥ kim etad iti nirūpaṇākārapravṛttaḥ /
manaḥsvabhāvo jalpo manojalpaḥ /
jalpa iva jalpo 'rthakathanam /
cetanāprajñāviśeṣa iti cetanāyāś cittaparispandātmakatvāt prajñāyāś ca guṇadoṣavivekākāratvāt /
tadvaśena cittapravṛtteḥ kadāciccittacetanayor vitarkaprajñaptiḥ ,
kadācit prajñācetasoḥ ,
yathākramam abhyūhānabhyūhāvasthāyoḥ /
athavā cetanāprajñayor eva vitarkaprajñaptiḥ ,
tadvaśena cittasya tathā pravṛttatvāt /
eṣa ca nayo vicāre 'pi draṣṭavyaḥ /
ittasyaudārikateti sthūlatā vastumātraparyeṣaṇākāratvāt //
vicāraḥ pratyavekṣako manojalpaḥ ,
idaṃ tad iti /
pūrvādhigatani[p. 74]rūpaṇāt /
tathaiva cittasya sūkṣmateti /
tathaiveti cetanāprajñāviśeṣaḥ /
paryeṣaṇato vastupratyavekṣaṇākāratvāt sūkṣma ucyate /
etau ca sparśāsparśavihārasanniśrayadānakarmakau /
anayoś caudārikasūkṣmavyavasthānāt pṛthakkaraṇam //
saṃskāraskandho vedanāsañjñāvyatiriktacaitasikātmakaś cittaviprayuktasaṃskārātmakaś cety uktam /
tatra caitasikā uktāḥ /
cittaviprayuktāḥ saṃskārā idānīṃ vaktavyā ity ata āha -- cittaviprayuktāḥ saṃskārāḥ katama iti //
praśnavat sāmānyatas tannirdeśaḥ -- ye rūpacittacaitasikāvasthāsu prajñapyante tattvānyatvataś ca na prajñapyante ,
te viprayuktāḥ saṃskārā iti prakaraṇāt sambadhyate /
rūpādyavasthāvyatiriktasvarūpābhāvāt te rūpādyavasthāsu saṃvyavahārārthaṃ prajñapyante /
ata eva svopādānāt tattvānyatvenāvasthāvan na prajñapyante ,
avasthāvasthāvator ekānekatvaprasaṅgād avasthāvataś ca kāryanityatvaprasaṅgāt /
sāmānyanirdeśād viśeṣānavagamād viśeṣabubhutsayā pra[p. 75]śnaḥ te punaḥ katama iti /
prāptir asañjñisamāpattir iti vistareṇa tadviśeṣanidarśanam /
evambhāgīyā evañjātīyāḥ /
ye 'nye 'pi rūpacittacaittāvasthāsu prajñapyante ,
te viprayuktāḥ saṃskārā veditavyāḥ /
te punaḥ katame /
pravṛttiḥ pratiniyamo yogo javo 'nukramaḥ kālo deśaḥ saṅkhyā sāmagrī cety evamādayaḥ /
idānīṃ sāmagryādīnāṃ pratyekaṃ svarūpanirdhāraṇārthaṃ praśnaḥ -- prāptiḥ katamety evamādiḥ /
pratilambhaḥ samanvāgama ityādi /
tat kilāyam (?) aprāptapūrvasya prathamataḥ prāptiḥ pratilambhaḥ /
prāptānāṃ dvitīyādiṣu kṣaṇeṣu prāptiḥ samanvāgamaḥ ,
samanugamaḥ samanvāgama iti kṛtvā /
evaṃ ca prāptiśabdaḥ pratilambhe samanvāgame ca vartata iti jñāpitaṃ bhavati /
sā punar bījaṃ vaśitā sammukhībhāvaś ceti tridhā bhidyate yathāyogam iti /
tatrāyaṃ yogaḥ -- prathamāt kṣaṇād ārabhya prāptir yāvad vaśitāvasthaṃ bījam ucyata iti pratilambhasamanvāgamau bījākhyau bhavataḥ ,
vaśitā sammukhībhāvaś ca samanvāgama eva /
kiṃ punar bījam /
kuśalākuśalāvyākṛtair dharmair āhito vijñāne 'nāgatatajjātīyadharmahetuḥ sāmarthyaviśeṣo bījam /
bīje hi labdhe tadāyattatvād asammukhībhūtam api yasya tad bījaṃ tatprāptam ucyate /
vaśitā punas tasya pra[p. 76]tyayān apekṣyāpratibandhena svakāryanirvartanāvasthā /
sammukhībhāvas tatkāryanirvṛttyavasthā //
asañjñā vā samāpattir asañjñisamāpattir asañjñānām vā samāpattir ity asañjñisamāpattiḥ /
śubhakṛtsnavītarāgasyeti tṛtīyadhyānavītarāgasyeti /
tṛtīyaṃ dhyānaṃ parīttaśubhāḥ ,
apramāṇaśubhāḥ ,
śubhakṛtsnāś ca /
tatra yaḥ śubhakṛtsnebhyo vītarāgaḥ ,
sa tṛtīyād dhyānād vītarāgaḥ /
nordhvaṃ tṛtīyād dhyānād ūrdhvaṃ caturthaṃ dhyānam ,
caturthād dhyānād avītarāgasyety arthaḥ /
niḥsaraṇasañjñāpūrvakeṇeti /
niḥsaraṇasañjñā pūrvaṃ yasya manasikārasya ,
sa niḥsaraṇasañjñāpūrvakaḥ /
āsañjñike mokṣasañjñinaḥ samāpattau vā tanmārgasañjñino 'sañjñisamāpattiṃ samāpadyante /
ato niḥsaraṇasañjñā mokṣasañjñā tanmārgasañjñā vā /
vidūṣaṇākāro 'tra niḥsaraṇasañjñāpūrvako manasikāro 'bhipretaḥ /
ata eva sarvacittacaittanirodhe 'pi sañjñābhāva eva nirdiśyate 'sañjñisamāpattir iti /
tathā hi sañjñām eva vidū[p. 77]ṣayan niravaśeṣacittacaittanirodhaṃ prāpnoti /
asthāvarāṇāṃ cittacaitasikānāṃ yo nirodha iti /
asthāvarāḥ pravṛttivijñānasaṅgṛhītāḥ sasamprayogāḥ ṣaḍvijñānakāyāḥ /
sarvāsv acittikāsv avasthāsv abhāvāt sacittikāsv apy avasthāsu ye na sarvadā bhavanti te 'sthāvarāḥ /
sthāvaram ālayavijñānaṃ sasamprayogam ,
sarvadā bhāvāt ,
kliṣṭaṃ ca manaḥ ,
anāsravamārgasatyasamāpattyavasthāṃ nirodhasamāpattyavasthām aśaikṣāvasthāṃ ca hitvānyāsu sarvāsv avasthāsu bhāvāt -- ity asthāvarāṇām iti
yo nirodha iti samāpatticittakṛtaḥ kālāntaram asthāvaracittacaittasamudācāravirodhy āśrayasyāvasthāviśeṣaḥ /
nirudhyate 'neneti nirodhaḥ /
evaṃ cāśrayāvasthāviśeṣe asañjñisamāpattiḥ prajñapyata ity uktaṃ bhavati /
samāpatticittenānantaraṃ cittāntarotpattiviruddha āśrayo yaḥ ,
sa samāpatticittena kṛta ity ucyate //
nirodhasamāpattir ākiñcanyāyatanavītarāgasya bhavāgrād [p. 78] uccalitasyeti /
bhavāgrād anuccalito 'py asty ākiñcanyāyatanavītarāgaḥ pṛthagjana ity ata āha -- bhavāgrāduccalitasyeti /
bhavāgrād uccalita ākiñcanyāyatanavītarāgo 'py asti kaścit phalasthaḥ pratipannakaś ca bhavāgrād uccalita ākiñcanyāyatanād avītarāgo 'py asti
kaścit phalasthaḥ pratipannakaś cety ata āha -- ākiñcanyāyatanavītarāgasyeti /
upary avītarāgasyety avacanam ,
bhavāgravītarāgasyārhato 'pi nirodhasamāpattisambhavāt /
ākiñcanyāyatanavītarāgasya bhavāgrād uccalitasyety ubhayābhidhānena āryasyaiveyam anāgāmino 'rhato vā samāpattiḥ ,
na pṛthagjanasyeti jñāpitaṃ bhavati /
na hi pṛthagjano bhavāgrād uccalati ,
bhavāgrapratipakṣasya mārgasyābhāvāt /
darśanamārgas tu bhavāgrapratipakṣo bhāvanāmārgaś cānāsravaḥ /
ata ārya eva bhavāgrād uccalitaḥ ,
darśanaprahātavyakleśaprahāṇāc ca virajya /
vihārasañjñāpūrvakeṇa manasikāreṇeti na [p. 79] hi nirodhasamāpattim asañjñāsamāpattim iva niḥsaraṇasañjñāpūrvakeṇa manasikāreṇa samāpadyante
kiṃ tarhi vihārasañjñāpūrvakeṇa /
nirodhasamāpattir bhavāgrakī ,
na cāryāṇāṃ bhave niḥsaraṇasañjñā pravartate /
sañjñāveditaparikhinnas tadabhāvān nirodhasamāpattau śāntavihārasañjñī bhavati /
vihāra iti sañjñā vihārasañjñā ,
viharaty anena iti vā vihāraḥ /
kālāntaraṃ yāpayatīty arthaḥ /
nirvāṇasadṛśena samāpattiviśeṣeṇa vihariṣyāma ity anayā sañjñayā saṃskṛto manasikāro vihārasañjñāpūrvako manasikāra ucyate /
sa punar bhavāgrikaḥ śūkṣmaḥ ,
tadanantaraṃ nirodhasamāpattisammukhībhāvāt /
asthāvarāṇām iti ṣaṇṇāṃ pravṛttivijñānānāṃ caturṇām ekasya kāmarūpārūpyadhātuṣu yathākramaṃ nirodhaṃ samāpadyamānānām /
ekatīyānāṃ ca sthāvarāṇāmiti /
sthāvarā iti vipākavijñānasaṅgṛhītā api santīty ata āha -- ekatīyānām iti /
kliṣṭasya ca manasaḥ sarvasmin sāsrave cāre sthānaśīlatvāt sthāvaratvam anyatra nirodhasamāpattyaśaikṣāvasthayoḥ /
nirodha iti samāpattivijñānakṛto vipākavijñāne pravṛttivijñānānāṃ kliṣṭasya ca manaso bījopaghātaḥ /
nirudhyate 'nena pravṛttivijñānaṃ kliṣṭaṃ [p. 80] ca manaḥ kālāntaram apravṛttita iti nirodha ucyate /
evaṃ cālayavijñānasya samāpatticittenopahatabījāvasthāyāṃ nirodhasamāpattiḥ prajñapyate //
āsañjñikam asañjñisamāpatteḥ phalam asañjñisattveṣu deveṣūpapannasyāsthāvarāṇāṃ cittacaitasikānāṃ dharmāṇāṃ yo nirodhaḥ /
bṛhatphalā nāma devāś caturthe dhyāne tṛtīyaṃ sthānāntaram /
teṣāṃ parigaṇā ivopary asañjñisattvānāṃ devānāṃ sthānaṃ ,
tatropannasyāsañjñisamāpattivipākaphalam /
asthāvarāṇāṃ cittacaittānāṃ yo nirodha iti tatsvarūpāvadhāraṇam /
tatra hy upapannasyāsthāvarāś cittacaittāḥ svāśraye svajātīyacittacaittabījopaghāte vartamānāḥ kṣāmakṣāmatarā utpadyante ,
